Arakhin 18b:7-19a:2: Tanu rabbanan: shana haamura bekadashim, shana haamura bevatte are choma, shete shanim shebbisde achuzza, veshesh shanim shebbeeved ivri, vechen shebbabben veshebbabbat — kullan meet leet.
Shana haamura bekadashim, menalan? amar rav acha bar yaakov, amar kera: "keves ben shenato", shenato shello, velo shel minyan olam.
Shana haamura bevatte are choma — dichtiv: "ad tom shenat mimkaro", mimkaro shello, velo shana leminyan olam.
Shete shanim shebbisde achuzza, dichtiv: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", peamim sheadam ochel shalosh tevuot bishte shanim.
Shesh shebbeeved ivri — dichtiv: "shesh shanim yaavod uvashsheviit", zimnin devishviit name yaavod.
Veshebbabben veshebbabbat kullan meet leet. lemay hilcheta? amar rav giddel amar rav: laarachin. rav yosef amar: lefirkin deyotze dofen".

Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mi peligitu? amar leh: la, ana amari chada, vehu amar chada. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach peligi, man deamar laarachin la amar leyotze dofen"? vehaamar rav: hilcheta bechulle pirka meet leet.
Veella leman deamar laarachin, may tama la amar leyotze dofen"? dumeya dehanach, ma hanach dichtiva, af hanach dichtiva.
Veiddach, i salka datach dichtiva, hay "shebbabben veshebbabbat" —
Umay shena nekeva, dechi mizzakna kayyma attilleta, umay shena zachar dela kae attilleta? amar chizkiyya: amri inashe: sava beveta — pacha beveta, savta beveta — sima beveta.
Beitzah 36b:13-37a:8: Gemara lo olin bailan — gezera shemma yitlosh.
Velo rochvin al gabbe behema — gezera shemma yetze chutz lattechum. shema minna techumin deorayyta! ella: gezera shemma yachtoch zemora.
Velo shatin al pene hammayim — gezera shemma yaase chavit shel shayyaytin.
Velo metappechin velo mesappekin velo merakkedin — gezera shemma yetakken kele shir.
Veellu hen mishshum reshut: lo danin. veha mitzva kaaved! la tzericha, deikka daadif minneh.
Velo mekaddeshin. veha mitzva kaaved! la tzericha,
Lo choltzin velo meyabbemin. veha mitzva ka aved! la tzericha, deikka gadol, umitzva baggadol leyabbem.
Vechullehu tama may — gezera shemma yichtov.
Veellu hen mishshum mitzva: lo makdishin velo maarichin velo macharimin — gezera mishshum mikkach umimkar.
Velo magbihin terumot umaasrot. peshita! tane rav yosef: lo nitzrecha ella littenah lechohen bo bayyom.
Vehane mille pere ditvili meetmol, aval pere ditvili haiddana, kegon issa leafroshe minna challa — mafreshinan veyahavinan lechohen.
Vehane, mishshum reshut ikka, mishshum shevut lekka? vehane, mishshum mitzva ikka, mishshum shevut lekka?
Amar rabbi yitzchak, la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya shevut geredta deasur, ella afillu shevut dirshut name asur. vela mibbaya shevut dirshut deasur, ella afillu shevut demitzva name asur.
Berakhot 63a:13-19: Darash bar kappara: ezohi parasha ketanna shekkol gufe tora teluyin bah — "bechol derachecha daehu vehu yeyashsher orchotecha". amar rava: afillu lidvar avera.
Darash bar kappara: leolam yelammed adam et beno ummanut nekiyya vekalla. ma hi? amar rav chisda: machta detalmiyyuta.

Tanya, rabbi omer: al yemanne adam appotroppos betoch beto, sheilmale lo minna potifar et yosef appotroppos betoch beto — lo ba leoto davar.
Tanya, rabbi omer: lamma nismecha parashat nazir lefarashat sota — lomar lach shekkol haroe sota bekilkulah yazzir atzmo min hayyayin.

Amar chizkiyya bereh derabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nismecha parashat sota lefarashat terumot umaasrot — lomar lach: kol sheyyesh lo terumot umaasrot veeno notnan lakkohen, sof nitzrach lakkohen al yede ishto, shenneemar: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu", usemich leh "ish ish ki tiste ishto", uchetiv "vehevi haish et ishto" vegomer. velo od ella sof shennitzrach lahen, shenneemar: "veish et kodashav lo yihyu".
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: veim netanan, sof mitashsher, shenneemar: "ish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye", "lo yihye" — mamon harebe.

Mishnah Chagigah 1:7-2:3:
Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer, ezehu meuvvat sheeno yachol litkon, ze habba al haerva veholid mimmenna mamzer. im tomar begonev vegozel, yachol hu lehachaziro vitakken. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer, en korin meuvvat ella lemi shehaya metukkan battechilla venitavvet, veeze, ze talmid chacham happoresh min hattora: 
Hetter nedarim porchin baavir, veen lahem al ma sheyyismochu. hilchot shabbat, chagigot vehammeilot, hare hem kahararim hatteluyin besaara, shehen mikra muat vahalachot merubbot. haddinin vehaavodot, hattohorot vehattumot vaarayot, yesh lahen al ma sheyyismochu. hen hen gufe tora: 
En dorshin baarayot bishlosha. velo vemaase vereshit bishnayim. velo vammerkava beyachid, ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato. kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim, rauy lo keillu lo ba laolam, ma lemala, ma lematta, ma lefanim, uma leachor. vechol shello chas al kevod kono, rauy lo shello ba laolam: 
Yose ben yoezer omer shello lismoch, yose ben yochanan omer lismoch. yehoshua ben perachya omer shello lismoch, nittay haarbeli omer lismoch. yehuda ben tabbay omer shello lismoch, shimon ben shatach omer lismoch. shemaya omer lismoch. avtalyon omer shello lismoch. hillel umenachem lo nechleku. yatza menachem, nichnas shammay. shammay omer shello lismoch, hillel omer lismoch. harishonim hayu nesiim, usheniyyim lahem av bet din: 
Bet shammay omrim, meviin shelamim veen somchin alehem, aval lo olot. uvet hillel omrim, meviin shelamim veolot vesomchin alehem:
Mishnah Chagigah 2:4-7:
Atzeret shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, bet shammay omrim, yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. uvet hillel omrim, en yom tevoach achar hashshabbat. umodim sheim chal lihyot beshabbat, sheyyom tevoach achar hashshabbat. veen kohen gadol mitlabbesh bechelav, umuttarin behesped uvetaanit, shello lekayyem divre haomrin atzeret achar hashshabbat: 
Notlin layyadayim lechullin ulemaaser velitruma. ulekodesh, matbilin. ulechattat, im nitmeu yadav, nitma gufo: 
Hattovel lechullin vehuchzak lechullin, asur lemaaser. taval lemaaser vehuchzak lemaaser, asur litruma. taval litruma, vehuchzak litruma, asur lekodesh. taval lekodesh vehuchzak lekodesh, asur lechattat. taval lechamur, muttar lekal. taval velo huchzak, keillu lo taval: 
Bigde am haaretz midras lapperushin. bigde ferushin midras leochle teruma. bigde ochle teruma midras lakkodesh. bigde kodesh midras lechattat. yosef ben yoezer haya chasid shebbakkehunna, vehayta mitpachto midras lakkodesh. yochanan ben gudgeda haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh kol yamav, vehayta mitpachto midras lachattat:
Mishnah Chagigah 3:1-4:
Chomer bakkodesh mibbatteruma, shemmatbilin kelim betoch kelim latteruma, aval lo lakkodesh. achorayim vetoch uvet hatztzevita batteruma, aval lo vakkodesh. hannose et hammidras nose et hatteruma, aval lo et hakkodesh. bigde ochle teruma, midras lakkodesh. lo chemiddat hakkodesh middat hatteruma, shebbakkodesh mattir umenaggev umatbil veachar kach kosher, uvatteruma kosher veachar kach matbil: 
Kelim hannigmarin betohora, tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma. harvii bakkodesh pasul, vehashshelishi batteruma. uvatteruma, im nitmet achat miyyadav, chavertah tehora. uvakkodesh, matbil shetehen, shehayyad metamma et chavertah bakkodesh, aval lo batteruma: 
Ochlin ochalim neguvin beyadayim mesoavot batteruma, aval lo bakkodesh. haonen umechussar kippurim tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, aval lo latteruma: 
Chomer batteruma, shebbihuda neemanim al tohorat yayin veshemen kol yemot hashshana, uvishat haggittot vehabbaddim af al hatteruma. avru haggittot vehabbaddim veheviu lo chavit shel yayin shel teruma, lo yekabbelenna mimmennu, aval mannichah laggat habbaa. veim amar lo, hifrashti letochah reviit kodesh, neeman. kadde yayin vechadde shemen hamedummaot, neemanin alehem bishat haggittot vehabbaddim, vekodem laggittot shivim yom:
Mishnah Chagigah 3:5-8:
Min hammodiit velifnim, neemanin al kele cheres. min hammodiit velachutz, en neemanim. ketzad, hakkaddar shehu mocher hakkederot, nichnas lifnim min hammodiit, hu hakkaddar vehen hakkederot vehen hallokchim, neeman. yatza, eno neeman: 
Haggabbain shennichnesu letoch habbayit, vechen haggannavim shehecheziru et hakkelim, neemanin lomar, lo naganu. uvirushalayim neemanin al hakkodesh, uvishat haregel af al hatteruma: 
Happoteach et chavito, vehammatchil beissato al gav haregel, rabbi yehuda omer, yigmor. vachachamim omrim, lo yigmor. mishsheavar haregel, hayu maavirin al tohorat azara. avar haregel beyom shishshi, lo hayu maavirin, mippene chevod hashshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, af lo veyom chamishi, sheen hakkohanim penuyin: 
Ketzad maavirim al tohorat azara. matbilin et hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, veomrin lahem, hizzaharu shello tiggeu bashshulchan uvammenora utetammeuhu. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, yesh lahem sheniyyim ushelishim, sheim nitmeu harishonim, yaviu sheniyyim tachtehen. kol hakkelim shehayu vammikdash, teunin tevila, chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet, mippene shehen kakkarka, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, mippene shehen metzuppin:
Mishnah Menachot 4:2-5:
Happarim vehaelim vehakkevasim enan meakkevin ze et ze. rabbi shimon omer, im hayu lahem parim merubbim velo hayu lahem nesachim, yaviu far echad unesachav, velo yikrevu chullan belo nesachin: 
Happar vehaelim vehakkevasim vehassair enan meakkevin et hallechem, velo hallechem meakkevan. hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim, vehakkevasim enan meakkevin et hallechem, divre rabbi akiva. amar shimon ben nannas, lo chi, ella hakkevasim meakkevin et hallechem, vehallechem eno meakkev et hakkevasim, shekken matzinu, keshehayu yisrael bammidbar arbaim shana, karvu chevasim belo lechem, af kan yikrevu chevasim belo lachem. amar rabbi shimon, halacha kedivre ven nannas, aval en hattaam kidvarav, shekkol haamur bechummash happekudim, karav bammidbar. vechol haamur betorat kohanim, lo karav bammidbar. mishshebbau laaretz, karvu ellu vaellu. umippene ma ani omer yikrevu chevasim belo lechem, shehakkevasim mattirin et atzman belo lechem. lechem belo chevasim, en li mi yattirennu: 
Hattemidin enan meakkevin et hammusafim, velo hammusafim meakkevin et hattemidim, velo hammusafim meakkevin ze et ze. lo hikrivu cheves babboker, yakrivu ben haarbayim. amar rabbi shimon, ematay, bizman shehayu anusin o shoggin. aval im hayu mezidin velo hikrivu cheves babboker, lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. lo hiktiru ketoret babboker, yaktiru ben haarbayim. amar rabbi shimon, vechullah hayta kereva ben haarbayim, sheen mechannechin et mizbach hazzahav ella viktoret hassammim, velo mizbach haola ella vetamid shel shachar, velo et hashshulchan ella velechem happanim beshabbat, velo et hammenora ella veshiva neroteha ben haarbayim: 
Chavitte chohen gadol, lo hayu vaot chatzayim, ella mevi issaron shalem, vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza vabboker, umechetza ven haarbayim. vechohen shehikriv mechetza beshacharit umet uminnu chohen acher tachtav, lo yavi chatzi issaron mibbeto, velo chatzi esrono shel rishon, ella mevi issaron shalem, vechotzehu, umakriv mechetza, umechetza aved. nimtzeu shene chatzayim kerevin, ushene chatzayim ovdin. lo minnu chohen acher, mishshel mi hayta kereva. rabbi shimon omer, mishshel tzibbur. rabbi yehuda omer, mishshel yorshim. ushelema hayta kereva:
Mishnah Menachot 5:1-4:
Kol hammenachot baot matztza, chutz mechametz shebbattoda ushete hallechem, shehen baot chametz. rabbi meir omer, seor bode lahen mittochan umechammetzan. rabbi yehuda omer, af hi enah min hammuvchar, ella mevi et hasseor, venoten letoch hammidda, umemalle et hammidda. amru lo, af hi hayta chasera o yetera: 
Kol hammenachot nilloshot befoshrin, umeshammeran shello yachamitzu. veim hechemitzu sheyareha, over belo taase, shenneemar (Vayikra b), kol hammincha asher takrivu laAdonai lo tease chametz. vechayyavim al lishatah, veal arichatah, veal afiyyatah: 
Yesh teunot shemen ulevona, shemen velo levona, levona velo shemen, lo shemen velo levona. veellu teunot shemen ulevona, minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat kohanim, uminchat kohen mashiach, uminchat goyim, uminchat nashim, uminchat haomer. minchat nesachin teuna shemen, veen teuna levona. lechem happanim taun levona, veen taun shamen. shete hallechem, minchat chote uminchat kenaot, lo shemen velo levona: 
Vechayyav al hashshemen bifne atzmo, veal hallevona bifne atzmah. natan aleha shemen, pesalah. levona, yilketenna. natan shemen al sheyareha, eno over belo taase. natan keli al gabbe keli, lo fesalah:
Mishnah Menachot 5:5-8:
Yesh teunot haggasha veenan teunot tenufa, tenufa velo haggasha, haggasha utenufa, lo tenufa velo haggasha. ellu teunot haggasha veenan teunot tenufa, minchat hassolet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat kohanim, minchat kohen mashiach, minchat goyim, minchat nashim, minchat chote. rabbi shimon omer, minchat kohanim, minchat kohen mashiach, en bahen haggasha, mifne sheen bahen kemitza. vechol sheen bahen kemitza, en bahen haggasha: 
Ellu teunin tenufa veen teunin haggasha, log shemen shel metzora vaashamo, vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, veemure shalme yachid vechaze vashok shellahen, echad anashim, veechad nashim, beyisrael aval lo vaacherim, ushete hallechem, ushene chivse atzaret. ketzad hu ose, noten shete hallechem al gabbe shene chevasim, umanniach shete yadav millemattan, molich umevi, maale umorid, shenneemar (Shemot 29), asher hunaf vaasher huram. tenufa hayta vammizrach, vehaggasha bammaarav. utenufot kodmot lehaggashot. minchat haomer uminchat kenaot, teunot tenufa vehaggasha. lechem happanim uminchat nesachim, lo tenufa velo haggasha: 
Rabbi shimon omer, shelosha minim teunim shalosh mitzvot, shetayim bechol achat veachat, vehashshelishit en bahen. veellu hen, zivche shalme yachid, vezivche shalme tzibbur, vaasham metzora. zivche shalme yachid, teunim semicha chayyim, utenufa shechutim, veen bahem tenufa chayyim. zivche shalme tzibbur, teunim tenufa chayyim ushechutim, veen bahen semicha. vaasham metzora, taun semicha utenufa chay, veen bo tenufa shachut: 
Haomer hare alay bemachavat, lo yavi vemarcheshet. bemarcheshet, lo yavi vemachavat. uma ben machavat lemarcheshet, ella shehammarcheshet yesh lah kissuy, vehammachavat en lah kissuy, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi chananya ven gamliel omer, marcheshet amukka umaaseha rochashim, umachavat tzafa umaaseha kashim:
Mishnah Menachot 5:9-6:4:
Haomer hare alay battannur, lo yavi maafe chuppach umaafe reafim umaafe yorot haarviyyim. rabbi yehuda omer, im ratza, yavi maafe chuppach. hare alay minchat maafe, lo yavi mechetza challot umechetza rekikin. rabbi shimon mattir, mippene shehu karban echad: 
Ellu menachot nikmatzot usheyarehen lakkohanim, minchat solet, vehammachavat, vehammarcheshet, vehachallot, veharkikin, minchat goyim, minchat nashim, minchat haomer, minchat chote, uminchat kenaot. rabbi shimon omer, minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet, vehakkometz karev leatzmo, vehashshirayim kerevin leatzman: 
Minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach uminchat nesachim, lammizbeach, veen bahem lakkohanim. baze yafe choach hammizbeach mikkoach hakkohanim. shete hallechem velechem happanim, lakkohanim, veen bahem lammizbeach. uvaze yafe choach hakkohanim mikkoach hammizbeach: 
Kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli teunot shalosh mattenot shemen, yetzika, uvelila, umattan shemen bakkeli kodem laasiyyatan. vehachallot bollan, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim, solet. hachallot teunot belila, harkikim meshuchin. ketzad moshchan, kemin chi. ushear hashshemen neechol lakkohanim: 
Kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli, teunot petita. minchat yisrael, kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, umavdil. minchat kohanim, kofel echad lishnayim, ushenayim learbaa, veeno mavdil. minchat kohen hammashiach, lo haya mechappelah. rabbi shimon omer, minchat kohanim uminchat kohen mashiach, en bahem petita, mippene sheen bahem kemitza, vechol sheen bahem kemitza, en bahen petita. vechullan kazzetim:
Mishnah Menachot 6:5-7:1:
Kol hammenachot teunot shelosh meot shifa vachamesh meot beita. vehashshifa vehabbeita bachittim. rabbi yose omer, af babbatzek. kol hammenachot baot eser eser, chutz millechem happanim, vachavitte chohen gadol, shehem baot shetem esre, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, kullan baot shetem esre, chutz mechallot toda vehannezirut, shehen baot eser eser: 
Haomer haya va issaron mishshalosh sein. shete hallechem, shene esronim mishshalosh sein. lechem happanim, esrim vearbaa esronim meesrim vearba sein: 
Haomer haya menuppe bishlosh esre nafa. ushete hallechem bishtem esre. velechem happanim beachat esre. rabbi shimon omer, lo haya lah kitzba, ella solet menuppa kol tzarkah haya mevi, shenneemar (Vayikra kad), velakachta solet veafita otah, ad shettehe menuppa kol tzarkah: 
Hattoda hayta vaa chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot, shehen shesh midbariyyot, shete efot, haefa shalosh sein, esrim issaron, asara lechametz vaasara lammatztza. asara lechametz, issaron lechalla. vaasara lammatztza, uvammatztza shelosha minin, challot urekikim urevucha. nimtzeu shelosha esronot ushelish lechol min, shalosh challot leissaron. bemidda yerushalmit hayu sheloshim kav, chamishsha asar lechametz, vachamishsha asar lammatztza. chamishsha asar lechametz, kav vachetzi lechalla. vachamishsha asar lammatztza, vehammatztza shelosha minin, challot urekikim urevucha, nimtzeu chameshet kabbim lechol min, shete challot lekav:
Mishnah Menachot 7:2-5:
Hammilluim hayu vaim kammatztza shebbattoda, challot urekikim urevucha. hannezirut hayta vaa shete yadot bammatztza shebbattoda, challot urekikim, veen bah revucha, nimtzeu asara kabbim yerushalmiyyot, shehen shishsha esronot vaaduyan. umikkullan haya notel echad measara teruma, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol karban teruma laAdonai. echad, shello yittol parus. mikkol karban, sheyyehu chol hakkarbanot shavin, veshello yittol mikkarban lachavero. lakkohen hazzorek et dam hashshelamim lo yihye, vehashshear neechol labbealim: 
Hashshochet et hattoda bifnim, velachmah chutz lachoma, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah ad shello karmu vattannur, vaafillu karmu chullan chutz meachad mehen, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah chutz lizmannah vechutz limkomah, kadash hallachem. shechatah venimtzet terefa, lo kadash hallachem. shechatah venimtzet baalat mum, rabbi eliezer omer, kadash, vachachamim omrim, lo kadash. shechatah shello lishmah, vechen el hammiluim vechen shene chivse atzeret sheshshechatan shello lishman, lo kadash hallachem: 
Nesachin shekkadshu vichli venimtza hazzevach pasul, im yesh sham zevach acher, yikrevu immo. veim lav, yippaslu velina. velad toda utemuratah, vehammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha, enan teunim lechem, shenneemar (Vayikra 7), vehikriv al zevach hattoda, hattoda teuna lechem, velo veladah velo chalifatah velo temuratah teunin lachem: 
Haomer hare alay toda, yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser, yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin, yavi. hattoda hi velachmah min hammaaser, yavi. velo yavi mechitte maaser sheni, ella mimmeot maaser sheni:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:1-2:
Hamechannes challot al menat lehaferish, venashchu, bet shammay omrim, chibbur bitvul yom. uvet hillel omrim, eno chibbur. mikratzot noshchot zo vazo, vechikkarot noshchot zo vazo, haofe chamita al gabbe chamita ad shello karmu vattannur, vekolit shel mayim hamechulchelet, uretichat gerisin shel pol rishona, uretichat yayin chadash, rabbi yehuda omer, af shel orez, bet shammay omrim, chibbur bitvul yom. bet hillel omrim, eno chibbur. umodim bishar kol hattumot, ben kallot ben chamurot: 
Hamechannes challot al menat shello lehaferish, haofe chamita al gabbe chamita mishshekkarmu vattannur, vekolit shel mayim sheenah mechulchelet, uretichat gerisin shel pol sheniyya, uretichat yayin yashan, veshel shemen leolam, veshel adashim, rabbi yehuda omer, af shel tofach, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 1:3-2:1:
Masmer sheachar hakkikkar, vegarger melach katan, vecharchur pachut mikkaetzba, rabbi yose omer, kol shehu neechol alav, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot: 
Hatztzeror shebbakkikkar, vegarger melach gadol, vehatturmos, vehacharchur yater mikkaetzba, rabbi yose omer, kol sheeno neechol immo, tehorim beav hattuma, veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom: 
Hasseora vehakkussemet bizman sheenan kelufim, hattia vehachiltit vehaalum, rabbi yehuda omer, af afunim shechorim, tehorim beav hattuma, veen tzarich lomar bitvul yom, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, tehorim bitvul yom, utemeim bechol hattumot. hasseora vehakkussemet bizman shehen kelufim, vehachitta ben shehi kelufa ben sheenah kelufa, hakketzach, vehashshumshom, vehappilpel, rabbi yehuda omer, af afunim levanim, temeim bitvul yom, veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot: 
Mashke tevul yom, kemashkin shehu nogea bahen. ellu vaellu, enan metammein. ushear kol hattemein, ben kallin ben chamurin, hammashkin hayyotzim mehen, kammashkin shehu nogea bahen. ellu vaellu techilla, chutz min hammashke shehu av hattuma:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:2-6: Kedera shehi melea mashkim venaga bah tevul yom, im haya mashke teruma, hammashkin pesulin vehakkedera tehora. veim haya mashke chullin, hakkol tahor. veim hayu yadav mesoavot, hakkol tame. ze chomer bayyadayim mibbitvul yom. vechomer bitvul yom mibbayyadayim, shessefek tevul yom posel et hatteruma, vehayyadayim sefekan tahor:

Hammikpa shel teruma vehashshum vehashshemen shel chullin, shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan, pasal et kullam. hammikpa shel chullin vehashshum vehashshemen shel teruma, shennaga tevul yom bemiktzatan, lo fasal ella mekom maggao. veim haya hashshum merubbe, holchin achar harov. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehen gush bakkeara. aval im haya mefuzzar bammedocha, tahor, mippene shehu rotze befizzuro. ushear kol hanniddochin sheddachan bemashkin. aval et sheddarkan laduch bemashkim vedachan shello vemashkin vehen gush bakkeara, hare ellu cheiggul shel devela:
Hammikpa vehachamita shel chullin vehashshemen shel teruma tzaf al gabbehen, venaga tevul yom bashshemen, lo fasal ella hashshemen. veim chibbetz, kol makom sheholech hashshemen, pasal:

Besar hakkodesh shekkaram alav hakkippa, naga tevul yom bakkippa, chatichot muttarot. naga bachaticha, chaticha vechol haolim immah, chibbur ze laze. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shenehem chibbur ze laze. vechen bekitniyyot shekkarmu al gabbe ferusot. maase kedera vakkitniyyot, bizman shehen perudim, enan chibbur. bizman shehen gush, chibbur. im hayu gushin harebe, hare ellu yimmanu. shemen shehu tzaf al gabbe hayyayin venaga tevul yom bashshemen, lo fasal ella hashshemen. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, shenehem chibbur ze laze:

Chavit sheshshaka letoch bor shel yayin venaga bo tevul yom, missafa velifnim, chibbur. min hassafa velachutz, eno chibbur. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, afillu al gabbah rum koma venaga keneged piha, chibbur:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:7-3:2: Chavit shennikkeva ben mippiha ben mishshuleha ben mitztziddeha venaga bo tevul yom, temea. rabbi yehuda omer, mippiha umishshuleha, temea. min hatztzedadin, mikkan umikkan, tehora. hameare mikkeli lichli venaga tevul yom bakkilluach, im yesh bo, yaale veachat umea:

Bibua shebbechavit shennikkav ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz uven milmalan ben millemattan, ze cheneged ze, tame veav hattuma vetame veohel hammet. happenimi millematta vehachitzon milmalan, tame veav hattuma vetame veohel hammet. happenimi milmalan vehachitzon millemattan, tahor beav hattuma vetame veohel hammet:

Kol yedot hoochalim shehem chibbur beav hattuma, chibbur bitvul yom. ochel shennifras umeore miktzat, rabbi meir omer, im ochez baggadol vehakkatan ole immo, hare hu chamohu. rabbi yehuda omer, im ochez bakkatan vehaggadol ole immo, hare hu chamohu. rabbi nechemya omer, battahor. vachachamim omrim, battame. ushear kol hoochalim, et sheddarko leachez beale, ochez oto beale. uvakkelach, ochazin oto bakkalach:
Yarak shel teruma uvetza terufa netuna al gabbav, venaga tevul yom babbetza, lo fasal ella hakkelach shekkenegdo. rabbi yose omer, kol hasseder haelyon. im haya chemin kova, enah chibbur:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 3:3-6:
Chut shel betza shekkaram al defanot shel lefas, venaga bo tevul yom, min hassafa velifnim, chibbur. min hassafa velachutz, eno chibbur. rabbi yose omer, chut vechol shenniklaf immo. vechen bekitniyyot shekkarmu al sefatah shel kedera: 
Issa shennidmea o shennitchammetza visor shel teruma, enah nifselet bitvul yom. rabbi yose verabbi shimon poslin. issa shehuchshera vemashke venillosha beme ferot venaga bahen tevul yom, rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, pasal et kullah. rabbi akiva omer mishshemo, lo fasal ella mekom maggao: 
Yarak shel chullin shebbishshelo veshemen shel teruma, venaga bo tevul yom, rabbi elazar ben yehuda ish bartota omer mishshum rabbi yehoshua, pasal kullah. rabbi akiva omer mishshemo, lo fasal ella mekom maggao: 
Tahor shennagas min haochel venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. haya ochel zetim petzuim utemarim retubbot, kol shehu rotze lamotz et garinato venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tame. haya ochel zetim neguvin utemarim yeveshot, kol sheeno rotze lamotz et garinato venafal al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma, tahor. echad tahor veechad tevul yom, kaellu. rabbi meir omer, ellu vaellu temein bitvul yom, shemmashkin shel tame machshirin lirtzono veshello lirtzono. vachachamim omrim, en tevul yom tame:
Mishnah Tevul Yom 4:1-5:
Ochel maaser shehuchshar bemashke, venaga bo tevul yom o yadayim mesoavot, mafrishin mimmennu terumat maaser betohora, mippene shehu shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin: 
Haishsha shehi tevulat yom, lasha et haissa, vekotza lah challa umafrashtah, umannachtah bichfisha mitzrit o vinchuta, umakkefet vekora lah shem, mippene shehi shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin: 
Areva shehi tevulat yom, lashin bah et haissa vekotzin mimmenna challa, umakkefet vekorin lah shem, mippene shehi shelishi, vehashshelishi tahor lechullin: 
Lagin shehu tevul yom, umilahu min hechavit maaser tevel, im amar, hare zo terumat maaser mishshettechshach, hare zo terumat maaser. im amar, hare ze eruv, lo amar kelum. nishbera hechavit, hallagin betivlo. nishbar hallagin, hechavit betivlah: 
Barishona hayu omrim, mechallelin al perot am haaretz. chazru lomar, af al meotav. barishona hayu omrim, hayyotze vakkolar veamar, kitvu get leishti, hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. chazru lomar, af hamefaresh vehayyotze vishyara. rabbi shimon shezuri omer, af hamesukkan:
Mishnah Yevamot 1:1-2:1:
Chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam. veellu hen, bitto, uvat bitto, uvat beno, bat ishto, uvat benah, uvat bittah, chamoto veem chamoto, veem chamiv, achoto meimmo, vaachot immo, vaachot ishto, veeshet achiv meimmo, veeshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vechallato, hare ellu potrot tzarotehen vetzarot tzarotehen min hachalitza umin hayyibbum ad sof haolam. vechullan im metu, o meanu, o nitgarshu, o shennimtzeu ayloniyyot, tzarotehen muttarot. vei atta yachol lomar bachamoto uveem chamoto uveem chamiv shennimtzeu ayloniyyot o shemmeenu: 
Ketzad potrot tzarotehen. hayta bitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesua leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, vamet, keshem shebbitto petura, kach tzaratah petura. halcha tzarat bitto venisset leachiv hashsheni, velo ishsha acheret, vamet, keshem shetztzarat bitto petura, kach tzarat tzaratah petura, afillu hen mea. ketzad im metu tzarotehen muttarot, hayta vitto o achat mikkol haarayot haellu nesua leachiv, velo ishsha acheret, meta vitto o nitgarsha, veachar kach met achiv, tzaratah mutteret. vechol hayechola lemaen velo meana, tzaratah choletzet velo mityabbemet: 
Shesh arayot chamurot meellu, mippene shennesuot laacherim, tzarotehen muttarot. immo, veeshet aviv, vaachot aviv, achoto meaviv, veeshet achi aviv, veeshet achiv meaviv: 
Bet shammay mattirin hatztzarot laachim, uvet hillel osrim. chaltzu, bet shammay poslin min hakkehunna, uvet hillel machshirim. nityabbemu, bet shammay machshirim, uvet hillel poslin. af al pi sheellu osrin veellu mattirin, ellu poslin veellu machshirin, lo nimneu bet shammay millissa nashim mibbet hillel, velo vet hillel mibbet shammay. kol hattohorot vehattumot shehayu ellu metaharin veellu metammein, lo nimneu osin tohorot ellu al gabbe ellu: 
Ketzad eshet achiv shello haya veolamo. shene achim, umet echad mehem, venolad lahen ach, veachar kach yibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, vamet, harishona yotzet mishshum eshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar vamet, hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityabbemet:
Mishnah Yevamot 2:2-5:
Shene achim umet echad mehen, veyibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv, veachar kach nolad lahen ach, vamet, harishona yotzet mishshum eshet achiv shello haya veolamo, vehashsheniyya mishshum tzaratah. asa vah maamar, vamet, hashsheniyya choletzet velo mityabbemet. rabbi shimon omer, meyabbem leezo mehen sheyyirtze, o choletz leezo mehen sheyyirtze: 
Kelal amru vayvama. kol shehi issur erva, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. issurah issur mitzva, veissur kedushsha, choletzet velo mityabbemet. achotah shehi yevimtah, choletzet o mityabbemet: 
Issur mitzva, sheniyyot middivre sofrim. issur kedushsha, almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lenatin umamzer: 
Mi sheyyesh lo ach mikkol makom, zokek et eshet achiv leyibbum, veachiv lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo min hashshifcha umin hannachrit. mi sheyyesh lo ben mikkol makom, poter eshet aviv min hayyibbum, vechayyav al makkato veal killato, uveno hu lechol davar, chutz mimmi sheyyesh lo min hashshifcha umin hannachrit:
Mishnah Zavim 5:11-12:
Baal keri, kemagga sheretz. uvoel nidda, kitme met, ella shechamur mimmennu boel nidda, shehu metamme mishkav umoshav tuma kalla letamme ochalin umashkin: 
Ellu foslim et hatteruma. haochel ochel rishon, vehaochel ochel sheni, vehashshote mashkin temein, vehabba rosho verubbo bemayim sheuvin, vetahor shennaflu al rosho veal rubbo shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, vehassefer, vehayyadayim, utevul yom, vehoochalim vehakkelim shennitmeu vemashkim:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:10-11: Yesh lannotel litten al yadav meat meat ad sheyyitten kashshiur. veim natan harviit kullah bishtifa achat kasher. notlin arbaa o chamishsha ze betzad ze o yad ze al gabbe ze bishtifa achat. uvilvad sheyyarpu yedehen kede sheyyavo benehen hammayim. veyihye beotah hashshetifa kede reviit lechol echad veechad:

En notlin mayim layyadayim lo bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bacharasim velo bimgufat hechavit. veim tikken hammegufa lintila notlin mimmenna layyadayim. vechen hachemet shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim. aval sak vekuppa shennitkenu en notlin mehen layyadayim. velo yitten lachavero bechafnav sheen chafnav keli. vechelim shennishberu shevira hametaheret otan mide tuma en notnin bahem layyadayim mippene shehen shivre kelim:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:12-14: Bechol hakkelim notlim layyadayim vaafillu kele gelalim uchele adama. vehu sheyyihyu shelemim. keli sheeno machazik reviit o en bo reviit en notnin mimmenna layyadayim:

Hakkol kesherin litten layyadayim afillu cheresh shote vekatan. im en sham acher manniach hakkeli ben birkav vetzak al yadav. o yatte hechavit al yadav veyittol. o notel yado achat vetzak bezo al zo vechozer vetzak barishona al hashsheniyya. vehakkof notel layyadayim:

Hashshoket sheddole adam beyado o begalgal venoten letochah vehammayim nimshachin mimmenna baamma veholchin umashkin hayerakot o habbehema vehinniach yadav bashshoket veavru hammayim veshatfu al yadav lo alta lo netila. shehare en kan noten al yadav. veim hayu yadav kerovot lishfichat haddeli ad shennimtzeu hammayim shatfu al yadav mikkoach netinat haadam alta lo netila:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:3-4: Netilat yadayim ben tavshil letavshil reshut. ratza notel ratza eno notel. uferot shel chullin enan tzerichin netilat yadayim ben battechilla ben bassof. vechol hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach. kol pat shehammelach bo tzarich netilat yadayim baacharona shemma yesh bo melach sedomit o melach shettivo kemelach sedomit veyaavir yadav al enav visamme. mippene ze chayyavin littol yadayim besof kol seudda mippene hammelach. uvemachane peturim minnetilat yadayim battechilla mippene shehen terudim bemilchama. vechayyavin baacharona mippene hassakkana:
Ad hechan hi netilat yadayim. ad happerek. vechamma shiur hammayim. reviit lechol shete yadayim. vechol shechotztzim bitvila chotzetz bintilat yadayim. vechol haole lemiddat mikve ole leshiur reviit:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:5-7: Kol hatztzarich netilat yadayim vehitbil yadav beme mikve eno tzarich davar acher. veim hitbilan bemayim sheen bahem shiur mikve o bemayim sheuvin shebbakkarka lo asa kelum sheen hammayim sheuvin metaharin et hayyadayim ella bintila:

Kol hannotel yadav tzarich lehizzaher bearbaa devarim. bammayim atzman shello yihyu pesulin lintilat yadayim. uvashshiur sheyyihye bahen reviit lechol shete yadayim. uvakkeli sheyyihyu hammayim shennotlin bahen bichli. uvenotel sheyyihyu hammayim bain mikkoach noten:

Arbaa devarim poslin et hammayim. shinnuy mare. vegilluy. vaasiyyat melacha bahen. vehefsed shemmonea et habbehema millishtot mehen. ketzad. mayim shennishtannu maritan ben bechelim ben bekarkaot ben mechamat davar shennafal letochan ben mechamat mekoman hare ellu pesulin. vechen im nitgallu gilluy haoser otan mishshetiyya nifselu lintilat yadayim:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6:8-9: Kol mayim shennaasa bahen melacha naasu shofchin ufesulin lintilat yadayim. ketzad. mayim sheuvin shehediach bahen kelim o sheshshara bahem pitto vechayyotze beze ben bechelim ben bekarkaot pesulin lintilat yadayim. hediach bahen kelim mudachin o chadashim lo pesalan. mayim shehannachtom metabbel bahen et hakkeachim pesulin. veshehu chofen mehen bishat lisha kesherim. shehammayim shebbechafnav hen shennaasu bahen melacha. aval hammayim shechofen mehem hare hen bechashrutan:

Vechol mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat kelev. kegon shehayu marim o meluchim o achurin o reach ra ad shello yishte mehen hakkelev. bechelim pesulin lintilat yadayim uvekarkaot kesherim lehatebil. chamme teverya bimkoman matbilin bahem et hayyadayim. aval im natal mehen bichli o shehiflig mehen amma lemakom acher en notlin mehen lo rishonim velo acharonim mippene sheenan reuyin lishtiyyat behema:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:17-18:
Hammefis shechin beshabbat kede leharechiv pi hammakka kederech sheharofin osin shehen mitkavvenin birfua leharechiv pi hammakka hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish shezzo hi melechet harofe. veim hefisa lehotzi mimmenna hallecha shebbah hare ze muttar: 
Hamesattet et haeven kol shehu chayyav mishshum makke befattish. hametzadded et haeven bisod habbinyan vetikkenah beyado vehoshivah bammakom harauy lah chayyav mishshum makke befattish. halloket yabbolet sheal gabbe begadim beyado kegon ellu hayyabbolot shebbichle tzemer chayyav mishshum makke befattish. vehu sheyyakpid alehen. aval im hesiran derech esek hare ze patur. hamenaer tallit chadasha shechora kede lenaotah ulehasir hatztzemer hallavan hannitle bah kederech shehaummanin osin chayyav chattat. veim eno makpid muttar:
Nedarim 7b:4-8b:1: Amar rav chanin amar rav: hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto, veim lo niddahu — hu atzmo yehe benidduy. shekkol makom shehazekarat hashshem metzuya, sham aniyyut metzuya.
Vaaniyyut, kemita, shenneemar: "ki metu kol haanashim", vetanya: kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem", o mita o oni.

Amar rabbi abba: hava kaemna kammeh derav huna, shama lehach itteta deappika hazekarat hashshem levattala, shammeta ushera la lealtar beappa. shema minna telat: shema minna hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto, ushema minna: niddahu befanav, en mattirin lo ella befanav, ushema minna: en ben nidduy lahafara velo kelum.
Amar rav giddel amar rav: talmid chacham menadde leatzmo, umefer leatzmo. peshita? mahu detema: "en chavush mattir atzmo mibbet haasurin", ka mashma lan.
Hechi dame: ki ha demar zutera chasida, ki michayyayv bar be rav shamta — meshammet nafsheh beresha, vahadar meshammet bar be rav. vechi ayel leveteh, share lenafsheh vahadar share leh.
Minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzva, shenneemar: "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha".
Vahalo musheba veomed mehar sinay hu. ella ha ka mashma lan deshare leh leinish lezaroze nafsheh.

Veamar rav giddel amar rav: haomer "ashkim veeshne perek ze" "eshne massechta zo" — neder gadol nadar lelohe yisrael. vahalo musheba veomed hu, veen shevua chala al shevua! may ka mashma lan, daafillu zaroze bealma — hayeynu derav giddel kammayyta!
Ha ka mashma lan: kevan dei bae patar nafsheh bikriyyat shema shacharit vearvit, mishshum hachi chayel shevua aleh.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: haomer lachavero "nashkim venishne perek ze" — alav lehashekim, shenneemar: "vayyomer elay (ben adam) kum tze el habbika vesham adabber otach vaetze el habbika vehinne sham kevod Adonai omed".
Amar rav yosef: nidduhu bachalom, tzarich asara bene adam lehattir lo, vehu detanu hilcheta, aval matnu vela tanu — la. vei lekka detanu hilcheta — afillu matnu vela tanu.
Vei lekka — lezil velittev apparashat derachim veyahev shelama leve asra, ad demikkali leh asra degamri hilcheta.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: yada man shamteh, mahu delishre leh? amar leh: leshammoteh shavveyu shaliach, lemishre leh la shavveyu shaliach.
Amar leh rav acha lerav ashe: shammetuy ushero leh bechelmeh, may? amar leh: keshem shei efshar labbar belo teven,
Kach i efshar lachalom belo devarim betelim.
Niddah 31a:9-10: Tanu rabbanan: shelosha shuttafin yesh baadam — hakkadosh baruch hu, veaviv, veimmo. aviv mazria halloven, shemmimmennu atzamot, vegidim, vetzippornayim, umoach shebberosho, veloven shebbaayin. immo mazraat odem, shemmimmennu or, uvasar, usearot, veshachor shebbaayin. vehakkadosh baruch hu noten bo ruach, uneshama, ukelaster panim, ureiyyayt haayin, ushemiat haozen, vedibbur pe, vehilluch raglayim, uvina, vehasekel.
Vechevan shehiggia zemanno lehippater min haolam, hakkadosh baruch hu notel chelko vechelek aviv veimmo, manniach lifnehem. amar rav pappa: hayeynu deamri inashe "putz milcha ushedi bisra lechalba".

Shevuot 46a:14-46b:5: Nigzal ketzad? hayu meidin oto shennichnas leveto lemashkeno kulei. vedilma lo mishkeno? mi la amar rav nachman: hay man dinkit narga bideh, veamar: "ezil veekteleh ledikla diflanya", veishtechach diktil ushede – la amrinan dehu katleh?
Alma avid inish degazem vela aved, hacha name – degazem vela aved! ema "umishkeno". velichze may mishkeno? amar rabba bar bar chana, amar rabbi yochanan: betoano kelim hannittalin tachat kenafav.
Amar rav yehuda: rauhu shehitmin kelim tachat kenafav veyatza,

Veamar "lekuchin hen beyadi" – eno neeman. vela amaran ella baal habbayit sheeno asuy limkor kelav, aval baal habbayit heasuy limkor et kelav – neeman. vesheen asuy limkor et kelav name – la amaran ella devarim sheen darkan lehatemin, aval devarim sheddarkan lehatemin – neeman.

Vesheen darkan lehatemin name – la amaran ella inish dela tzenia, aval inish ditznia – hayeynu orcheh. vela amaran ella ze omer "sheulin" veze omer "lekuchin", aval bignuvin – lav kol keminneh; leachzoke inish begannave la machzekinan.

Vela amaran ella bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, aval devarim sheen asuyin lehasheil ulehaskir – neeman. dishlach rav huna bar avin: devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, veamar "lekuchin hen beyadi" – eno neeman. ki ha derava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme, bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir.
Amar rava: afillu shomer nishba, afillu ishto shel shomer nishbaat. bae rav pappa: sechiro ulekito may? teku.
Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: teano bechasa dechaspa, may? chazena: i inish daamid hu, o inish dimheman hu demafkedi inashe gabbeh – mishteva veshakel. vei la – la.
Zohar, Emor 40: Ta chaze, behay yoma itkasseyay sihara, vela nahir ad beasor lachodesh, deyisrael tayyvin kullehu betiyyuveta shelemata, veima illaa tavat venaharat lah. vehay yoma nehiru deima natla, veishtechach chedu becholla. veal da ketiv, yom hakkippurim hu. yom kippur mibbae leh, man yom hakkippurim. ella begin ditre nehorin naharin bechad. butzina illaa, nahir levutzina tattaa. uvehay yoma minnehora illaa nahir. vela minnehora deshimsha uvegin kach bakkese leyom chaggenu ketiv.

Ribbi abba shalach leh lerabbi shimon, amar, ematay ziuuga dichneset yisrael bemalka kaddisha. shalach leh, (Bereshit 20:12) vegam amna achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat immi vattehi li leishsha. itregish ribbi abba, arim kaleh, bacha veamar, ribbi ribbi butzina kaddisha, vavy, vavy lealma kad tippuk minneh, vavy ledara dihon bealma kad tistallak minnehon veyishtaarun yatmin minach. amar leh ribbi chiyyay leribbi abba, hay deshalach lokovlach. may kaamar.

Amar vday lav ziuuga demalka bematronita, ella bezimna denahara meabba illaa, vechad itnahara minneh, karenan lah kodesh deha mibbe abba natla hay. ucheden mizdavvevge kachada, begin demalka kodesh ikre, dichtiv, (yirmeya b) kodesh yisrael laAdonai, denatil meatar deikre kodesh. keden achoti vat avi hi ach lo vat imi, deha mibbe abba shema da, vela mibbe imma, veal da vattehi li leishsha, leizdavvevga kachada, bezimna da, vela bezimna ochora, bezimna denatla mibbe abba, vela bezimna denatla mibbe imma. veyom hakkippurim ochach, detashmish hammitta asur, begin deziuuga la ishtechach, deha mibbe imma natla, vela mibbe abba. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday zakkaa dara derabbi shimon share begavvih, zakkain innun dekayymin kammeh kol yoma.

Amar ribbi abba, berosh hashshana nivra adam, vekaim bedina kamme mareh, vetav betiyyuveta, vekabbil leh kudesha berich hu. amar leh, adam, ant tehe simana livnayich ledare darin, behay yoma kayymin bedina, vei yetuvun ana akabbel lon, veekum mikkuresyay dedina, veetkayyem al kuresyay derachame, vaarachem alayyhu. vedavid amar, (Tehillim 116:1) ahavti ki yishma Adonai et koli tachanunay. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 130:4) ki immecha hasselicha lemaan tivvare. uchetiv, (Tehillim 36:10) ki immecha mekor chayyim beorcha nire or. raya mehemna pikkuda (43) da, leitannaa beyoma dechippure, leachnea gufa venafsha, beraza dechamishsha innuyin, dechamishsha dargin deyoma dechippure. deha mekatrega ka ate leadkera chovehon, kema deittemar. vechullehu betiyyuveta shelemata kamme avuhon. kolla, kema deittemar bechamma duchete. (ad kan raya mehemana) (pikkuda 44 lemiflach kahana vechulei 63 amud alef)

(Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze yom hakkippurim hu mikra kodesh yihye lachem. ribbi chiyyay patach, (Tehillim 32:1) ledavid maskil ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa. ledavid maskil, ha tanenan bey zine zimra (nusach acher ittakkan) itkere sefer tehillim, benitzuach, benigun, bemaskil, bemichtam, bemizmor, beshir, beashre, bitfilla, behodaa, behaleluyah, veillaa mechullehu haleluyah, veha ukemuha.

Hacha maskil, atreh yedia, mahu maskil, mayya deachkimu leinnun deshatu lehu, hahu atar (sefer acher dameshatedalen behahu atar) deikre maskil, kema deat amer, (Mishlei 16:20) maskil al davar yimtza tov. uvegin deikre hache, talya beh selicha, cheru dechirin. hada hu dichtiv ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa.

May kesuy chataa. ha ukemuha, dehu kasuy mibbene nasha, hahu chattaa dechav lekudesha berich hu, veode kamme kudesha berich hu. aval (sefer acher kissuy chattaa) ta chaze, kad bar nash chate, vechav zimna chada, uteren utelata, vela ahdar beh, ha chovoy beitgalya innun umefarsseme lon leella, umefarsseme lon letatta. vecharoze azlin kammeh umachreze, istelaku missacharaneh diflanya, nazif hu mimmareh, nazif hu leella, nazif hu letatta, vavy leh defagim diyyukena demareh, vavy leh dela chayish likara demareh, kudesha berich hu galle choveh leella, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. vechad bar nash azil beorcha demareh, veishtaddal befulechaneh, veizdeman leh chattaa chad, kolla mechassin illavih, illain vetattain, da ikre kesuy chataa.
Amar leh ribbi abba, ad kean la matit leikara demilla. veshappir kaamart. vehay dekaamru chavrayyay shappir. aval i hachi, mechusse chattaa mibbae leh, mahu kesuy chattaa.

Ella tere mille dechachmeta it beh, vetarvavyyhu hachi. chad kema detanenan, deovadin tavin devar nash avid behay alma, avdin leh behahu alma levusha yakkira illaa, leitlabbesha behu. vechad bar nash atkin ovadin tavin, vegavrin aleh ovadin bishin, veashgach beh kudesha berich hu, veovadoy bishin saggiin, veihu rasha, deishtechach chataa kamme mareh, vetohe al innun tavan daavad bekadmita, ha itavid hu mikkolla, mehay alma, umealma deate. ma avid kudesha berich hu meinnun tavan daaved hay chattaa bekadmita.

Ella kudesha berich hu, af al gav dehahu rasha chattaa itavid. innun tavan vezachyayn la itavidu. it tzadik deazil bearchoy demalka illaa, veatkin levushoy meovadoy, vead la ashlim levushoy, istallak. kudesha berich hu ashlim leh, meinnun ovadin daavad (sefer acher daabad) hay rasha chattaa, veashlim levushoy, leittakkena behu behahu alma, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 27:17) yachin vetzaddik yilbash. hahu chattaa atkin, vetzadik itchappe mimma deihu takkin, hada hu dichtiv kesuy chataa, (kissuy hu mida dechataah itchafe mecheta) veal da la ketiv mechusse, ella kesuy.

Vechad, deitchappe hahu chattaa dehay zakkaa, beinnun deikrun metzulot yam, deha man denafil bimtzulot yam, la ishtechach lealmin begin demayin chafin alayyhu. (man metzulot yam) kema deat amer, (Micha 7:19) vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam. man metzulot yam. ella raza yakkira hu, veha (ukemuha rabbi shimon amar) okmeh ribbi shimon, veamar, kol innun deatu missitra takkifa, veitachadu bezinin bishin, bechitrin tattain, kegon azazel beyoma dechippure, da ikre metzulot yam. kezafta dechaspa, kad bachanin leh benura, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:4) hago sigim mikkasef.

Kach hay, meinnun metzulot yam hu, umetzulot yam ikre, metzulot mehahu yam kaddisha, metzulot, zuhama dechaspa. veal da, kol innun chatain deyisrael sharyayn legavvih (sefer acher legabbeh), vehu kabbil lon, veyishtaavun begavih. may taama. begin deihu chataa ikre. may chataa. girona. veal da hu girona decholla, venatal girona degufa udenafsha. behay yoma nachit hay metzulot yam, zuhama (dechaspa) denafsha, venatil zuhama degufa. man hu zuhama degufa. da innun chovin deitavedu al yede deyetzer hara, deikre mezoham menuval.

Amar ribbi yose, tenan (Vayikra 16:8) venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot, i hachi yekara hu daazazel, chamittun avda deshade advin bemareh, orchoy dealma deavda la natal ella ma deyahiv leh mareh. aval, begin desamael zammin hay yoma bediltora, uvegin dela yehe leh pitra (sefer acher behay adva hu salleka beh) yahavin leh chulaka behay.

Vehay adva miggarmeh hu desalik beh, deamar ribbi yehuda amar ribbi yitzchak, milla illaa ashkachna beadva. adva dihoshua, ketiv beh, (Bamidbar 26:56) al pi haggoral, al pi haggoral vadday, deihu amar da chulaka dihuda, da devinyamin vechulei, vechen kullehu. uf hacha, kevan dechahana shavvi yedoy, innun advin medallege vesallekin bida dechahana, (sefer acher vesallekin advin bida dechahana, inun medallege min yedoy) vesharan beatrayyhu. hada hu dichtiv, vehassair asher ala alav haggoral, ala alav vadday.

Vela da bilchodoy, ella bechol zimna dediltura zamin, veityeyhiv leh reshuta, baenan leshavava lokovleh bema deyitasak, veshavik lon leyisrael. behay yoma dalttora zammin lealla ara. hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 1:7) vayomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo. veha tanenan, mishshut baaretz, may hu. ella hay hu dilttora rabba mekatrega deyisrael.

Veha attearu chavrayyay, (devadday) behahi shaata dahavo zeminin yisrael lemebar yamma, uleitpara mimmitzrae, amar, ana avarna beara kaddisha, vachamena dela itchazun illen lemeal begavvav, i annet dain dina, dinayyhu hacha kemitzrae, ma shanyayn illen meillen, o yemutun kullehu kachada, o yehadrun kullehu lemitzrayim. velav ant hu deamart, (Bereshit 15:13) vaavadum veinnu otam 4 meot shana, veha la seliku mechushebanaya ella redu, vela yattir.

Amar kudesha berich hu, may abid, ishtaddeluta baya hacha, leayytaa kerava lokovleh, yahivna leh bema deyitasak, veyyishbok behu levanay, veha ishtechach beman deyitasak, miyyad amar leh, hasamta libbecha el avdi iyyov ki en kamohu baaretz. miyyad palig leh dalttora bemillin, vayaan hassatan et Adonai vayomar hachinnam yare iyyov elohim.

Leraya devae leabera aneh bechad nahara, abar zeeva lekatrega leh beaneh, raya hava chakkim, amar may abid, divod daana abar letalyay, yekatreg hu beane. zakaf enoy, vechama ben ana, chad tayysha meillen tayyshe bara, dehava rav vetakkif. amar, ashde da lokovleh, uveod dimkatrege da beda, abar lechol ana, veyishtezvun minneh.

Kach kudesha berich hu amar, vadday ha tayysha chad rav vetakkif vealim, ashde lekavleh, uveod dehu yishtedal beh, yaavrun banay, vela yishtekach kattegora legabbayyhu. miyyad, vayomer Adonai el hassatan hasamta libbecha. ad dekudesha berich hu zivvivg lehu kachada, dichtiv hinno veyadecha. beod dehu ishtaddal beh, shavik lon leyisrael, vela ishtechach kattegora legabbayyhu.

Uf hachi behay yoma, diltora zammin lealla ara, uvaena leshaddera lekovleh bema deyitasak (kegavvna dileh), uveod deihu ishtaddal beh, shavik lon leyisrael. umatla amre lezilzula deve malka, hav leh zeer chamra, vishabbechach kamme malka. vei lav yemma lemalka milla bisha. lezimnin natlin lah lehahi milla, illae deve malka, umalka avid dina begineh.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, leshatya dekaim kame malka, hav leh chamra, ulevatar ema leh, veachze leh, kol innun taavavn deavdat, vechol innun bishin, vehu yete vishabbechach, veyemma dela yishtekach bealma kevavtach. uf hacha, ha kaim daltora tadir kamme malka, yisrael yahavin leh hay doron, uvehay doron pitka, lechol bishin, ulechol taavavn, ulechol chovin deavdu yisrael, vehu ate umeshabbach lehu leyisrael, veitavid sannegora alayyhu, vekudesha berich hu ahdar kolla leresha devishe deammeh, begin dichtiv, (Mishlei 25:22) ki gechalim atta chote al rosho.

Amar ribbi yose, vavy lon leamma deesav, beshaata dehay sair meshaddere lehahu diltora memana dealayyhu, divgineh ate leshabbecha lon leyisrael, vekudesha berich hu ahdar kol innun chovin leresha deammeh, begin dichtiv, (Tehillim 101:7) dover shekarim lo yikkon leneged enay. amar ribbi yehuda, ilmale havo yade umot haolam mehay sair, la shavkin lon leyisrael, yoma chad bealma.

Ta chaze, kol hahu yoma mishtedal ihu behahu sair, uvegin kach kudesha berich hu mechapper lehu leyisrael, vedache lon mikkolla, vela ishtechach kategorya kammeh. levatar, hu ate umeshabbach lehu leyisrael. ucheden shail leh, kema deat amer, vayyomer Adonai el hassatan meayin tavo, ativ betushebachtayyhu deyisrael, vekategora itavid sanegora veazil leh.

Keden kudesha berich hu amar leshivin sarin desacharin kuresyay, chamittun hay diltora, heach kaim al banay tadir, (istekamu) ha seira chada deishtechach (sefer acher ishtaddar) gabbeh, befitka dechol chovayyhu vechol taavvatayyhu, vechol ma dechatu vechavu kammay, vehu kabbil lon. keden istekamu kullehu, deyahadrun innun chovin al ammeh.

Ribbi abba amar, kol innun chovin vechattain mitdabbekin beh, kema dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) vetashlich bimtzulot yam kol chattotam. ulevatar, kullehu mithadderan bereshehon deammeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam el eretz gezera. behay yoma mitattar kahana beitrin illain, vehu kaim ben illae vetattae, umechapper aleh veal beteh, veal kahane, veal makdesha, veal yisrael kullehu.

Tana, beshaata deal bedama defar, mechavvin beresha dimhemnuta, veade beetzbeeh, kema dichtiv, vehiza oto al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet vehech avid. basim bekifta (sefer acher baketapea) deetzbea, veade kematzlif, betifin deetzbea, lesitre kaftura (sefer acher kateaveraa) (sefer acher kapporta), ade veitkevvavn, veshari lemimne achat, achat veachat. achat bilchodaha, achat (tikun 82 amud alef, raya mehemana 108 amud bet) dechalil kolla, achat shevacha decholla, achat decholla ahadderan lakovlah, achat resha decholla. levatar achat veachat, deinnun sharyayn kachada, biruta beachvavta, vela mitparshan lealmin.

Batar demata lehay veachat, dehi imma decholla. mikkan share lemimne beziuuga, umane veamar, achat ushetayim. achat veshalosh. achat vearba. achat vechamesh. achat vashesh. achat vasheva. begin leamshacha ulenagda lehay achat, dehi imma (yamma) illaa, bedargin yedian, lechitra (sefer acher lenahara leimma) deima tattaa. uleamshacha naharin amikin meatrayyhu likkeneset yisrael. veal da, yoma da teren nehorin naharin kachada, imma illaa nahara leimma tattaa. veal da ketiv yom hakkippurim, kema deittemar.

Amar ribbi yitzchak kiftera chada keshira beragloy dechahana, beshaata dehava al, dei yamut hatam, yappekuhu millevar. uvemma yade. behahu zehorita ityeyda veishtemoda, kad la yehafech gavvnoy. behahi shaata ishtemoda, dechahana ishtechach lego bachattaa. vei yippuk bishlam, bizhorita ityeyda veishtemoda, deyehafech gavvnoy lechivvavr. keden chedvavta hi beillae vetattae. vei lav kullehu ishtechachu betzaara, vahavu yade kolla, dela itkebalu tzelothon.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kevan dehava al, vetimtem enoy dela leistakkela bema dela itzterich, vahava shama kal gadpe keruveyay mezammere umeshabbeche. hava yada kahana, decholla hava bechedva, veyippuk bishlam. veim kol da bitzloteh hava yada, demillin nafkin bechedvavta, umitkabbelan umitbarchan kedka yaut, ucheden chedvavta hi beillae vetattae.

Ribbi elazar shaal lerabbi shimon avoy, amar leh, hay yoma amay hu behay atar tale, vela bedarga ochora, deyeot hu lemehevi bedarga demalka share, yattir mikkolla. amar leh ribbi shimon, elazar beri, hachi hu vadday, veyaut shaalta.

Ta chaze, malka kaddisha, shavik hechaleh uveteh bida dematronita, veshavak livnoy immah, begin ledabbera lon, ulealkaa lon, ulemishre begavavyyhu. dei zakkan matronita alat bechedvavta bikara legabbe malka. vei la zakkan, hi veinnun, ithadaru begaluta. veha okimna, kema dichtiv, (Mishlei 19:26) meshadded av yavriach em. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 50:1) uvefishechem shullecha immechem.

Veal da it yoma chad beshatta, leashgecha behu, uleayyna behu. vechad izdeman hay yoma, imma illaa dechol cheru bidaha, izdeman lokovleh, leistakkela behu beyisrael. veyisrael izderazu behay yoma, bechamma pulechanin, bechamma tzelotin, bechamma innuyin, kullehu bizchuta. keden izdeman lehu cheru, meatar dechol cheru bidaha dematronita. bene malka benaha, deitpakdan bidaha, kullehu zakkain, kullehu bela chataan, bela chovin, keden izdavvevgat (sefer acher vechad izdaman hay yoma veyisrael izdemanu behay yoma bechamma pulechanin bechamma tzelotin bechamma innuyin kullehu bizchuta keden ema illaa dechol cheru bidaha izdammenat lekabbela leistakkela behu beyisrael vechamat bene malka benaha (nusach acher beraha) deitpakdan bidaha dematronita kullehu zakkain belo chatain belo chovin keden azemaynat lehu cheru meatar dechol cheru bidaha dematronita keden matronita illaa) legabbe malka, binhiru, bechedva, bishlimu, biruta. deha rabbiat benin lemalka illaa kedka yaut.

Vechad hay yoma la ishtechachu kedka yaut, vavy lon, vavy lishluchehon, vavy deha matronita itrachakat min malka, veima illaa istalakat, vela nafik minnah cheru lealmin. zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu olif lon orchoy, begin leishtezava min dina, veyishtachchun zakkain kammeh. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem. uchetiv, (yechezkel 36:25) vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem mikkol tumotechem vegomer.
Zohar, Vayakhel 17: Raza desefer tora beyoma da, ha ukemuha tanenan ketiv, (nechemya 8:8) veyikreu besefer betorat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu vammikra veha ukemuha raza, deinnun pissuke taame, umassoret, vechol innun diukin, (nusach acher tikkunin) verazin illain, kolla itmesar lemoshe missinay. i vechol hane diukin itmesar orayyta lemoshe, sefer tora deihu vechol innun kedushan, amay ihu chaser mikkol hane tikkunin verazin deitmesaru leh lemoshe beorayyta.

Ella raza da, kad kuresyyay kaddisha mitattera, veitkelilat battora shebbichtav, kol innun diukenin, vechol innun taamin umassorot, kullehu alin bignizu, veitreshimu bego kuresyyay kaddisha, veinnun diukenin, deail orayyta devichtav, beorayyta dival pe, uvehu itabberat, keitteta deitabberat min dechura, veishtaaru atvavn illain lechodayyhu bikdushayyhu kadka chaze. uleitchazaa beve kenishta, deha itbarchat veitatterat kuresyyay meraza detora shebbichtav, vetamman ail kol innun diukenin, veihi itkadshat minneh, bae leitchazaa beatvavn lechodayyhu kadka yeot.

Ucheden, kolla itkaddash bikdushsha illaa kadka chaze, kol shekken vekol shekken behay yoma. behay yoma bae lesalleka shiva guverin, lokovel shiva kalin, deinnun raza deorayyta. uvizmanin uvemoadin chamesh, go raza da. beyoma dechippure shit. go raza illaa da.

Vecholla raza chada. chamesh, deinnun chamesh dargin letatta, middarga deor kadmaa letatta, veinnun raza deorayyta. shit, deinnun shit sitrin vecholla raza chada. sheva innun sheva kalin. vechullehu raza chada, illen veillen.

Berosh chodesh ittosaf chad al telata, begin shimsha, denahir behahu zimna, lesihara, veittosaf nehora al sihara, vehayeynu raza (Bereshit 17 amud alef) demusaf. besefer tora, bae lishtema chad kala vedibbur.

Siddura lesaddera amma kaddisha beyoma da, uvishar yomin desefer tora bae lesaddera uletakkena tikkuna, bechad kurseyyay deikre teva, vehahu kurseyyay deliheve beshit (14 amud bet, 43 amud alef, shalach 164 amud bet) dargin, lesalleka behu vela yattir, dichtiv, (divre hayamim b 9:18) veshesh maalot lakkisse. vedarga chad leella, leshavvaa aleh sefer tora, uleachazaa leh lecholla.

Kad salik sefer tora letamman, keden baan kol amma lesaddera garmayyhu letatta, beemata bidchilu beretet bezia, ulechavvna libbayyhu, kemma dehashta kayyaymin al tura desinay lekabbela orayyta, veyehon tzayytin veyirchun udenayyhu. velet reshu leamma lemiftach pumehon, afillu bemille deorayyta, vechol shekken bemilla achara, ella kullehu beemata, keman delet leh puma veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (nechemya 8:Adonai) uchefitcho amdu chol haam. (nechemya 8:3) veazne chol haam el sefer hattora.
Amar rabbi shimon, kad mafkin sefer tora betzibbura, lemikre beh, mitpattechan tare shemayay derachamin, umeorrin et haahava leella, veive leh levar nash lememar hachi.

Bericha shemeh demare alma, berich kitrach veatrach, yehe reutach im ammach yisrael lealam, ufurekan yeminach, achze leammecha bevet mikdashcha, uleamtoye lana mittov nehorach, ulekabbela tzelotana berachamin. yehe raava kodamach, detorich lan chayyim betivu, veleheve ana pekida bego tzaddikayya, lemircham alay, ulemintar yati, veyat kol dili, vedi leammacha yisrael. at hu zan lecholla, umefarnes lecholla, at hu shallit al kolla, at hu deshallit al malchayya, umalchuta dilach hu. ana avda dekudesha berich hu, desagidna kammeh, umikkamme dikar orayyteh, vechol iddan veiddan. la al eynash rachitzna, vela al bar elahin samichna, ella beelaha dishmayya, dehu elaha keshot, veorayyteh keshot, uneviohi keshot, umasge lemebad tavvavn ukeshot. beh ana rachitz, velishmeh kaddisha yakkira ana emar tushebchan. yehe raava kodamach, detiftach libbay beorayytach vetehav li benin dichrin deavdin reutach. vetashlim mishalin delibbay, velibba dechol ammach yisrael letav ulechayyin velishlam amen.

Veasir lemikre besifra deorayyta, bar chad bilchodoy, vecholla tzayytin veshatkin, begin deyishmeun millin mippumeh, keillu kabbilu lah hahi shaata mittura desinay. uman dekare beorayyta, lehve chad kaim aleh, veshatik. dela yishtama bar dibbur chad bilchodoy, la teren dibburin, leshon kodesh chad, vechad hu, vela teren dibburin, vei teren mishtakkechin besefer tora, geriuta deraza dimhemnuta ihu ugeriuta diykara deorayyta ishtechach besefer tora, uvae chad kala. metargem chad. veraza da kelifa umocha. (raza dealma da veraza dealma deate).

Kolla shatkin, vechad kare, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle lemor ihu leella, vechol amma letatta, dichtiv, (Shemot 19:17) vayityatztzevu betachtit hahar. uchetiv (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim.

Vehahu dekare beorayyta, yeshavve libbeh ureuteh leinnun millin, vechi ihu shelicha demareh, besidura dehani millin, lemishma lechol amma, deha ihu kaim kedugema illaa. begin kach, man desalik lemikre beorayyta, yesader innun millin bekadmita beveteh, vei lav, la yikre beorayyta, menalan mehahu dibbur, ad la yashma orayyta leamma kaddisha ma ketiv, (iyyov 28:27-28) az raa vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah, ulevatar, vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vegomer.

Asir leh leman dekare beorayyta lemifsak parsheta, o afillu milla chada, ella baatar defasak moshe parsheta leamma kaddisha, yafsik. vela yafsik millin defarsheta deshabbeta da, befarsheta deshabbeta achara.

Raza da, beshaata deifsiku parshiyayn, kol chad vechad itattera vekayyeyma kamme kudesha berich hu. kevan deashlimu lemifsak hani parshiyayn dechol shatta, itattaru kammeh kudesha berich hu, veamre ana mishshabbat peloni, (sefer acher matzebaveraa peloni) vaana mishshabbat peloni. (matzebaveraa peloni)

Behahi shaata, kera leyufiel rav memana, ulechamshin utelat retichin kaddishin ditchot yedeh, deitmanun beshimusha deorayyta, vechol reticha ureticha mani leh, lehay reticha al parsheta pelanya, divshabbat peloni. ureticha peloni, al parsheta pelanya, deshabbat peloni. vechol chad vechad, meshammesha leorayyta, dehahu shabbat dileh. veasir lan learva illen beillen, vela leaala reticha birticha dechavreh, afillu kimlo nima. vaafillu bechad teva, o afillu beat chad, ella kol chad vechad, kemma defasik lon kudesha berich hu, uchemma demane lon beinnun parsheyayn, kol chad vechad al matreh.

Veal da, kad mitattera parsheta da, salkan innun millin dehahi parsheta, deishtelim betzibbura, venatil lon hahu reticha, dimmana behahi parsheta, vesalik lon kame kudesha berich hu, veillen millin mammash, kayymin kammeh veamrin, ana parsheta pelanya, deashlimu li tzibbura peloni, hachi vehachi.

I ishtelim kadka chaze leh, sallekin innun millin, umitatteran al kuresyay kaddisha, vehahu reticha meshammesha kammeh, kol reticha ureticha, parsheta dechol shabbeta veshabbeta, vechullehu mitatteran bego kuresyyay kaddisha, uvehu ihi salleka leityachada leella leella, veitavid kolla kelala chada. begin kach, zakkaa chulakeh man deashlim parsheta dechol shabbeta veshabbeta, kadka yaut, kema deafsiku leella.

Tere zimne, karenan besefer tora beshabbeta, bammincha, beshaata dedina talya, leidan erev. tzerichin leachlela semala bimina, deha orayyta mitterin (84 amud alef) sitrin ityeyhivat, dichtiv, (Devarim log) mimino esh dat lamo, yemina usemala. begin kach sefer tora bammincha day baasara pesukin, o yattir, aval la shelimu defarsheta, deha shelimu defarsheta la heve, ella bimina, vimina talyay ad shaata demincha, veha ukemuha.

Bashsheni beshabbeta, uvachamishi beshabbeta, begin deka nachtin dargin letatta, deinnun kelala deorayyta. vei tema, ha neviin mitparshan letatta. ella hachi hu vadday, aval hane diltatta, kullehu kelala deorayyta, vechol chad vechad kalil lechol chad vechad.

Veraza demilla, illen dargin illain, innun ikrun parsheta chada, ulevatar nafkin minnayyhu tesha dargin, deitachadan kachada, uvegin kach tisha guverin, telat beshabbeta bammincha, utelat beyoma tinyayna, utelat beyoma chamishaa, ha tisha.

rashi: Et hashshira hazzot. "haazinu hashshamayim" ad "vechipper admato ammo":
ohc: Veatta kitvu vegomer. amro "veatta", hagam shello haya moshe mitakkev laasot maamar Adonai techef umiyyad, nitkavven lezarzo lichtov techef umiyyad kodem tzauoto et yehoshua et haamur besamuch dichtiv (Devarim 31:14) "kera et yehoshua", shehagam shehavvaad haya letzauot yehoshua dichtiv "kera et yehoshua vegomer vaatzavvennu", af al pi chen chafetz Adonai lehakedim hakketiva shel hashshira velimmudah.

Vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 31:22) "vayyichtov moshe et hashshira vegomer vaylammedah" vegomer, veachar kach amar "vaytzav et yehoshua" vegomer, shehu hakkadosh baruch hu tzivva et yehoshua vechizzeko lehavi et yisrael, umin harauy haya lo ligmor kol maamar yitbarach asher yetzavve, veachar kach yekayyemu mitzvotav lichtov hashshira ulelammedah, ella hattaam hu lefi she tzivva lichtov ulelammed techef, uzerizut zo lo ba ella shello leakkev ad sheyyetzavve et yehoshua.

Velammedah vegomer simah befihem vegomer. shalosh mitzvot tzivva Adonai: achat, lichtov. sheniyya, lelammedah et bene yisrael sheyyedu kavvanat divre hashshira. shelishit, lesimah befihem leda keriatah.

Ushelashtan asa moshe, dichtiv "vayyichtov moshe et hashshira" (Devarim 31:22). 2, "vaylammedah et bene yisrael". 3, "vaydabber moshe beazne chol kehal yisrael et divre hashshira hazzot" (Devarim 31:30), perush, kara otah begirsa lahem bederech sheyyedu leamrah kederech sheamarah lahem, vehu amro "simah befihem".

rashi: Tachat hannaatzutz vegomer. rabbotenu darshu: tachat harshaim yaalu tzaddikim:
Naatzutz vsirpad – mine kotzim hem, kelomar: harshaim yovdu vehatztzaddikim yittelu memshaltam (Megila 10 2):
targum: Chalaf rashiaya vachalaf chayavaya yitkaymun dachale cheta vihe kodam Adonai leshum leat alam dela yifsok:

rashi: Ki lo machshevotay machshevotechem. en shelli veshellachem shavot, lechach ani omer lachem yaazov rasha darko, veyitpos et darki:

Veish aven machshevotav, veyitpos et machshevotay laasot hattov beenay. umidrash aggada (tanchuma Buber vayyeshev 11): ki lo machshevotay vegomer en dini kedine basar vadam: attem, mi shemmode baddin mitchayyev, aval ani "mode veozev yerucham" (Mishlei 28:13):
targum: Are la machshevatay machshavatchon vela orchatchon takanan keorchat tuvi amar Adonai:

rashi: Vehistarti fanay. kemo sheeni roe betzaratam:
ohc: Vaazavtim vegomer vehistarti fanay vegomer. hakkavvana ki im yitten Adonai dato ladaat hatztzarot asher yavou alehem, yehemu rachamav visallek charon appo, laze hu modia ki yastir panav, uvaze yimtzauhu tzarot rabbot.

Veamar bayyom vegomer. perush, sheyyeshaaru bedatam lerov hatztzara sheroin sheen ze ella letzad hasetarat panay mehem, vehu amro "halo", perush vadday sheal sheen elohay bekirbi metzauni vegomer, sheim haya bekirbi lo hayu kol kach tzarot bain alenu, vetze ulemad sheamar hannavi (Shoftim 10,16) "vattiktzar nafsho baamal yisrael", kivyachol.

rashi: Ki gavhu shamayim vegomer. kelomar, ki yesh hevdel vechilluk maalot veshevach biderachay yoter middarchechem uvmachshevotay yoter mimmachshevotechem, kegavoah shamayim al haaretz. attem notnim lev limrod bi, vaani noten lev lehashiv etchem:
targum: Are chema deramin shemaya min ara ken taknan orchatay meurechatchon umachashvati taknan mimachshevatchon:

rashi: Umachazikim. ochazim:
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai lesarisaya deyitrun yat yome shabbaya dili umitraan bidtzavena umatkefin bikyami:

rashi: Vihi Adonai misgav laddach. leshon "dakka" (tehillim 90:3), ilaminshi belaaz. leatid, kesheyyechonen lemishpat kiso, yehi misgav leyisrael, shehem dakkim:
Leittot batztzara. ittim shel tzara:
targum: Vihe memra dayya tekof lemaskena tekof beidane akta:

rashi: Vayyelech moshe vegomer, anochi hayyom. hayyom malou yamay ushenotay, beyom ze noladti uveyom ze amut (sota 13):

Lo uchal od latzet velavo. yachol shettashash kocho, talmud lomar "lo chahata eno velo nas lecho", ella mahu lo uchal? eni rashshay, shennittela mimmenni harshut venittena lihoshua. davar acher — latzet velavo. bedivre tora, melammed shennistemu mimmennu masorot umayenot hachachma (sota 13):
VaAdonai amar elay. zehu perush lo uchal od latzet velavo — lefi she amar elay:
ohc: Lo uchal od vegomer. lefi ma shepperashti shehikkir besilluk hanneshama hannikret moshe, amar "lo uchal" al derech amram besefer hazzohar (Zohar 9 217:) veze leshono: kad nafkat nishmata mibbar nash beinun (arbein) [telatin] yomin let bar nash shallit benishmateh.

Od nitkavven lomar lahem taam shehikkir shehayyom malu yamav ushenotav, vahagam sheamarnu hattaam midderech hatztzaddikim lehaalim hassagatam asher yassigu yoter al bene doram, velaze amar lahem taam hakkarato baddavar mishshene teamim: echad, "lo uchal od latzet velavo" shennittela mimmenni harshut venittena lihoshua. shenit, she amar elav "lo taavor et hayyarden hazze", mizze hikkir ki karvu yeme happekida:
Ulederech ze, "vaAdonai" natan taam lahem lechiuun "hayyom", veyavinu vah al hazzeman hammizdammen lefanav, sheyyityaches elav zichron shel "hayyom", kemo shepperashnu bemakom acher.

Od nitkavven bismichut "vaAdonai amar elay" lemaamar "lo uchal" vegomer, lehodia neemanut avduto labbore baruch hu, shehagam shello yuchal od latzet velavo, im yomar elav Adonai avor et hayyarden yihye mitazzer veomed umeshammesh lehachenisam laaretz, velo haya nimna mitztzad shello haya yachol latzet velavo, ella she amar elav "lo taavor" vegomer:

rashi: Hakehilu elay. velo taku oto hayyom bachatzotzrot lehakehil et hakkahal, lefi shenneemar (Bamidbar 10) "ase lecha", velo hishlit yehoshua alehem, veaf bechayyav nignezu — beyom moto — lekayyem ma shenneemar (Kohelet 8) "veen shilton beyom hammavet" (tanchuma vaychi vabehaalavetach):

Veaida bam et hashshamayim veet haaretz. veim tomar hare kevar heid lemala — "haidoti vachem hayyom vegomer"? hatam leyisrael amar, aval lashshamayim velaaretz lo amar, veachshav ba lomar "haazinu hashshamayim vegomer"(Devarim 32):

Ki atta tavo et haam hazze. "are at teul im amma haden": moshe amar lo lihoshua zekenim shebbaddor yihyu immecha, hakkol lefi datan vaatzatan, aval hakkabba amar lihoshua "ki atta tavi et bene yisrael el haaretz asher nishbati lahem" — tavi al karcham, hakkol taluy becha, tol makkel vehach al kadkodan, dabbar echad ledor velo shene dabbarim ledor (sanhedrin 8):
ohc: Ki atta tavo. velo amar tavi, ki Adonai hammevi otam, kemo sheamar lemala "Adonai elohecha hu haover vegomer hu yashmid", ella shehu yavo berosham. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 8.) bappasuk sheamar besof happarasha (Devarim 31:23) "ki atta tavi", sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu dabbar echad laddor, lefi shemmashmaut tavo sovelet gam ken acherim immo, laze ratza hakkadosh baruch hu sheyyefaresh devarav, uleolam kavvanat moshe hayta lehair ki Adonai hu hammevi, nimtzeta omer amar "tavo" likboa hammaase baAdonai ki hu hammevi, veamar "tavi" lishlol zulato mimmin haenoshi.

rashi: Haanashim. lilmod:
Vehannashim. lishmoa:
Vehattaf. lamma va? latet sachar limviehem (chagiga 3):
ohc: Hakehel et haam vegomer lemaan yishmeu ulemaan yilmedu vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal shene peamim tevat lemaan, velo hispik lomar "lemaan yishmeu veyilmedu", uchemo sheamar bappasuk sheachare ze sheamar "yishmeu velamdu"?

Venire ki lefi sheamar hakkatuv "hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf" likrot sefer tora beaznehem, uchevar kadam lanu ki hannashim enam bene talmud tora, dichtiv (Devarim 11:19) "velimmadtem otam et benechem", vedarshu zichronam livracha (kiddushin 29:) velo benotechem:

Laze chillek hakkatuv shete haderagot bemitzva zo, veamar bitchilla chalukka shehi shava baanashim uvannashim, vehu "lemaan yishmeu", perush sheyyishmeu mitzvot hattora shechayyavin hem laasot, vedavar ze shavim hem bo, sheggam hannashim chayyavin bemitzvot lo taase uvemitzvot ase sheen hazzeman gerama.
Veachar kach amar chalukka bifne atzmo keneged haanashim levad, vehu "ulemaan yilmedu" shehu talmud tora, velaze lo amar "lemaan yishmeu veyilmedu", sheaz haya nishma sheshshenehem beonesh echad.

Shuv raiti maamar chazal (chagiga 3.) sheamru veze leshonam: "hannashim lishmoa vehaanashim lilmod", ad kan. vehem devarenu atzmam, venitchakkemu lehakedim hannashim laanashim keseder shehikdim hakkatuv, "lemaan yishmeu", veachar kach "ulemaan yilmedu", uchemo shekkatavnu.

rashi: Chishshavti yamim mikkedem. lizkor hachasadim sheasita im avotenu:
targum: Meniti yomin tavin demin lekadmin shenaya tavaya demin almin:

rashi: Ken yihye devari asher yetze mippi. lehodiachem al yede hanneviim lo yashuv rekam, ach yetiv lachem im tishmeu lahem:
targum: Ken have pitgam tuvi denafek min kodamay la efshar deyituv likdamay rekan elahen avad yat deraena umatzlach lidshalachna leh:

rashi: Behamir aretz. leatid lavo, bayyom shenneemar "vehaaretz kabbeged tivle" (yeshaya 51:6). rau bene korach nes shennaasa lahem, shennivleu kol sevivotehem vehem amdu baavir, veamru leyisrael beruach hakkodesh, sheddugemat hannes hazze yihye asuy lahem leatid (sanhedrin 110.):
targum: Metul hechna la nidchal beidan deishtalchifu avahan min ara kad mitmottin turaya befalgus deyama rabba:

rashi: Tesham shomron. meatta tiggale ashmatah:
Hariyyotav. nashim meubbarot shebbetochah:
targum: Techov shomron are serevat al memar elaha becharba yitkatlun veulemehon yitarfun umadeyathon yitbazu:

rashi: Yaase zot. shomer shabbat vegomer:
targum: Tuve enash deyabad da uvar enasha deyitkef bah yitar shabbeta meachalute veyiter yedohi milmebad kol devish:

rashi: Ki vesimcha tetzeu. min haggalut:
Heharim vehaggevaot yiftzechu lifnechem rinna. sheyyittenu lachem piryam vetzimcham, veyehanu (yeronnu) yoshvehem:
targum: Are vechedva tifkun mibbene ammaya uvishlama tittovlun learachon turaya veramata yevuun kodamechon tushebcha vechol ilane chakla yishanun beanfehon:

rashi: Adonai malach. benatlo hammelucha meamalek umizzaro (Shemot 17:14-16):
Tagel haaretz. zehu sheamar (Yechezkel 35:14) "kismoach kol haaretz shemama eese lach", al amalek nitnabbe ken:
targum: Adonai melach tedutz ara yechdun nagvan sagiin:

rashi: Veanta hashshira hazzot lefanav leed. shehitreti vo vetochah al kol hammotzot oto:
Ki lo tishshachach mippi zaro. hare zo havetacha leyisrael sheen tora mishtakkachat mizzaram legamre:
Efrayim. yomar: "ma li od lalechet achare haatzabbim?" veyashuvu meavoda zara. (Melachim 1 12:28-29) ani eenehu mitztzarato:
Vaashurennu. ere beanyo:
Ani kivrosh raanan. ani lo nichpaf lihyot ochez yado bi, kivrosh raanan hannichpaf laaretz sheadam ochez baanafav, kelomar ehye matzuy lo:
Mimmenni peryecha nimtza. vahalo ani hu shekkol tovatcha meitti baa:
targum: Yemrun devet yisrael ma lana od lemiflach letaavata ana bememri akabbel tzelothon deyisrael veerchem alohi ana bememri abedineh kevirvan shappiran demin kodamay seliach lityuvethon mishtakkecha:

rashi: Hashachach channot. lihyot chonen, channot kemo "asot" (Bereshit 2:4) "reot" (Shemot 10:28), lashon acher: channot chaninot:
Im kafatz beaf rachamav sela. leshon "lo tikpotz yadcha" (Devarim 15:7), kelomar im sagar harachamim leolam bishvil hachema:
targum: Haefshar deitneshe lechayasa elaha in selik berugeze min lemichmar rachamoy lealmin:

ohc: Hen beodenni chay immachem. yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 18.) tzaddikim bemitatam keruyim chayyim, vehu amro "beodenni chay immachem", perush beod shehachayyim shelli immachem, ha lamadta sheachare ken hu chay gam ken ella sheeno immahem.
Veamro hayyom – ramaz sheen lo od immahem ella yom ze, ufeshat hakkatuv hu "ad hayyom".

Veamro heyitem – leshon avar, ki efshar shehirharu teshuva beotah shaa, uchedin hammekaddesh ishsha al menat shehu tzaddik gamur, af al pi shennimtza shehaya rasha gamur anu omrim shehi mekuddeshet, shemma hirher teshuva beotah shaa (kiddushin mat:).

rashi: Kol tissa avon. kol avonotenu selach:

Vekach tov. velammedenu derech tov. davar acher: meat maasim tovim shebbeyadenu kach beyadcha veshaftenu acharehem, vechen david omer "millefanecha mishpati yetze enecha techezena mesharim" (tehillim 17:2). davar acher: vekach tov – vekabbel hodaya meittanu, shenneemar "tov lehodot laAdonai" (tehillim 92:2):
Uneshallema farim. shehaya lanu lehakeriv lefanecha, neshallem otam beritztzuy divre sefatenu (yoma 86, 2):
targum: Kerivu imchon pitgamin deittodaa vetuvu lefulechana dayya amaru kadamohi kariv kodamach lemishbak al ivyan venitkabbel da ketavin vihevyan mile sifvatana mitkavlin kodamach ketorin leraava al madbacha:

rashi: Tikra et hattora hazzot. hammelech haya kore mittechillat "elle haddevarim", kidita vemassechet sota (daf 41) al bima shel etz shehayu osin baazara:
Nechar haaretz. goye haaretz:
ohc: Vekam haam hazze vegomer. kashe, vechi kima hi lo, vahalo yerida vehashepala hi lo hazzone achare elohe nechar? veulay sheyyechavven lomar al derech amro (Devarim 32:15) "vayyishman yeshurun vayyivat", vehu amro "vekam haam", perush, hayta lo kima baolam birushshat haaretz, veosher vechavod, vayyishman, umizze yatza lo sheyyivat vezana achare vegomer. vechen amar besamuch (Devarim 31:19) "kitvu lachem et hashshira hazzot vegomer ki aviennu vegomer veachal vesava vedashen ufana el elohim acherim" vegomer, hare shehikdim sava vedashen leufana", kemo chen bema shellefanenu hikdim lomar "vekam" veachar kach "vezana".

Od yirtze, ki lo haddor hahu atzmo yizne achare elohe nechar, ella haddor sheyyakum mimmennu, vechen hu omer besefer shoftim (2:8-12): "vayyamat yehoshua vegomer, vegam kol haddor hahu neesfu el avotav vayyakam dor acher vegomer vayyaasu vene yisrael et hara beene Adonai vayyaavdu et habbealim vegomer meelohe haammim asher sevivotehem", vehu amro "vekam vegomer vezana vegomer asher hu ba shamma bekirbo".

rashi: Lo yarpecha. lo yitten lecha rifyon lihyot neezav mimmennu:
Lifnot boker. leketz haggeulla:
targum: Shechinta dayya begavah la tazua yesayinah Adonai bizchuteh deavraham detzale ala leidane tzafra:

ohc: Uvenehem asher vegomer. chalukka zo keneged hattaf shehizkir befasuk "hakehel", amar hattaam hagam shello higgiu adayin lilmod, af al pi chen yishmeu velamdu leyira et hashshem, perush lechannecham leyira et Adonai:

Velaze lo amar kederech sheamar befasuk hakehel "yilmedu veyaru", shehem shene devarim, ella "velamdu leyira", perush shebbaze yilmedu yirat shamayim. veamro "kol hayyamim", ki keshehakketannim mitchannechim mittechillatam leyira yityassed bahem yirat Adonai kol yemehem:

Verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (chagiga 3.) veze leshonam: vehattaf lamma? litten sachar limviehem, ad kan. veulay shennotnim taam liktanne ketannim sheenam mevinim davar, sheggam hem nichlalim bichlal hattaf sheamar hakkatuv, uma shennatan hakkatuv taam "yishmeu velamdu", hu livnehen asher yatchilu haven.

rashi: Lakoach. kemo zachor (Shemot 20) shamor (Devarim Adonai), haloch (Yirmeyahu 2):

Mitztzad aron berit Adonai. nechleku vo chachme yisrael bevava batra (daf 14), yesh mehem omrim daf haya volet min haaron mibbachutz vesham haya munnach, veyesh omrim mitztzad halluchot haya munnach betoch haaron:
Nahar pelagav. shoshroyishilsh belaaz:
Nahar. gan eden (Bereshit 2:10):
targum: Amin hech naharin umabbuehon atyan umachdeyan karta dayya umetzalyan bevet mikdesheh dayya mashkeneh deilaa:

rashi: Mi chacham. bachem veyaven elle. mi chacham bachem veyitbonen latet lev lechol elle veyashuv elay:
Ufoshim yikkashlu vam. bishvilam, al shello halchu bahen. ken tirgem yonatan:
targum: Man chakkim deyisbar ilen suchelatan veyeddeinun are taknan orchata dayya vetzadikaya dehalichu bah yechun behon bechaye alma verashiaya yitmasrun legehinam al dela halichu vehon:

rashi: Mikketz sheva shanim. beshana rishona shel shemitta — bashsheminit, velamma kore otah shenat hashshemitta? sheadayyin sheviit noheget bah, bakkatzir shel sheviit hayyotze lemotzae sheviit:
Otam zachar. et haddamim shennishpechu beyisrael:
targum: Metul detavea dema dezakkaa yat tzadikaya dechir vela sheli kevelat invetanin:

rashi: Zammeru laAdonai yoshev tziyyon. kesheyyachazir yeshivato letziyyon yezammeru lo ken:
targum: Shabbachu kodam Adonai deashre shechinteh betzion taniu beammaya ovadoy:

rashi: Heafes. shemma kala chasdo?
Gamar omer. gezerat olam shello yashuv mecharono od?
targum: Haefshar di fesak lealmin tuveh shelim pitgam devish al kol dar vedar:

rashi: Behimmatzo. kodem gezar din, beod shehu omer lachem "dirshuni":
targum: Tevau dechalta dayya ad deattun chayin beo min kodamohi ad deattun kayamin:

rashi: Havedel yavdilani Adonai meal ammo. lamma etgayyer? halo hakkadosh baruch hu yavdileni meal ammo kesheyshallem secharam:
Veal yomar hassaris. lamma etiv derachay umaalalay? hen ani ketz yavesh, meen zikkaron:
targum: Vela yemar bar ammin demittosaf al ama dayya lememar afrasha yifreshinani Adonai meal ame vela yemar sarisa ha ana chashiv kea yavesh:

rashi: Od akabbetz alav. min haummot sheyyitgayyeru venilvu alehem:
Lenikbatzav. nosafim al kibbutze yisrael:
