targum: Amar Adonai elohim daatid lechanasha mevadre yisrael od akarev galvathon lechanasha yathon:

ohc: VaAdonai hu haholech lefanecha vegomer. velo amar elohecha, kederech sheamar leyisrael (Devarim 31:3), lefi sheen meyached shemo yitbarach al hatztzaddik bachayyim chayyuto (tanchuma toldot 7), aval lichlalut yisrael yityached shemo, keamro (Shemot 20:2) "anochi Adonai elohecha".

Veamro hu haholech. velo hispik lomar vaAdonai holech lefanecha, lehair shello yachshov bayyecholet hammatzuy beyisrael (lishmor) [lishmod] ki yachol yuchal lechol hammilchamot hammezummanot lefanav, ki lo bichaltam taluy haddavar, ella baAdonai levad hu taluy, vehu amro "hu haholech", velo beshittuf koach acher.

Hu yihye immach. amro "hu", lehodia ki madrega haggedola shehi kelalut hashshechina haholechet lifne machane yisrael, haderaga zo tihye immo, vehu amro "hu yihye immach", perush bechina hammuzkeret besamuch.

rashi: Vaatzavvennu. vaazarzennu:
ohc: Hen karvu yamecha vegomer. taam amro "hen", lehatzedik maamar moshe sheamar "ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom", vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota 13:) "hayyom malu yamay" vechulei, ad kan. uva devar Adonai elav, veamar "hen" kidvarecha karvu yamecha. veamro "karvu yamecha" velo amar "karav yomcha", al derech amro (Bereshit 47:29) "vayyikrevu yeme" vegomer uferashnuhu sham:

Od yirtze beamro "hen karvu" vegomer al ze hadderech, hinne hayyamim shellecha karvu etzlecha, vehayyamim hem chelke hanneshama hammitkarvim besod "tosef rucham yigvaun" (tehillim 104,29), uchemo shepperashnu sham befarashat vaychi, vehodio ki taam kirvat chelke hanneshama hannikraim yamim hu lamut.

Vehityatztzevu vegomer. kan tzivva sheyyitnaheg yehoshua bisrara lifne moshe, vehu amro "vehityatztzevu" leshon minnuy userara shenehem behashevaa, al derech shepperashnu befarashat attem nitztzavim (Devarim 29:9). veamro "vaatzavvennu", leshon malchut, al derech amro (Shmuel 1 13:14) "vaytzavvehu Adonai lenagid", vechen hu omer "ki atta tavi" (Devarim 31:23), vedarshu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 8.) tol makkel vehach al kadkodam.

rashi: Yashuvu yoshve vetzillo. otan shehayu kevar yoshvim betzel hallevanon, sheddimma bo yisrael uvet hammikdash (Hoshea 6:7), veachshav galu meimmo, yashuvu elav:
Zichro keyen levanon. "keducheran yavvot chatzotzrata deal chamar attik demitnassech bevet makdesha", shehayu tokin bachatzotzrot al hannesachim keshehalviyyim omrim bashshir:
targum: Yitkanshun mibbene galutehon yatvun bitlal meshichahon veyechun metaya veyisge tuva beara yehe dachran tavvathon alel vela fasek keducheran yabbevot chatzotzarta al chamar attik demitnasech bevet makdasha:

rashi: Veyach. hattal et sharashav veyatzlichem. kallevanon – kesharshe ilane hallevanon shehem gedolim:
targum: Yehe memri ketala leyisrael yizharun keshoshana veyatvun al tekof arahon keilan livnan dimshalach ovarteh:

rashi: Ezkera neginati ballayla. bime haggalut hazze haddome lallayla ani zocher et neginotay shehayiti menaggen bime kedem bevet hammikdash:
Im levavi asicha. ani mechashshev veruchi mechappes (Pesikta rabbati 17), ma hi ken middato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, vaani tameah: halleolamim yiznach?
targum: Edkar tushebachti belelya im hirhure libbevi amalel veyivlash nisaya manda deruchi:

rashi: Shuva yisrael. shebbeeretz yehuda, pen yikre etchem keshomron. lechach nismechu hainyanim. mashal lemelech shemmarda alav medina, shalach hammelech polimarchos veamar lehacharivah. haya oto polimarchos baki umeyushshav, amar lahem: telu lachem yamim, veim lav ani ose lachem kederech sheasiti limdina pelonit ulechavroteha, uleipparchiyya pelonit ulechavroteha. lechach neemar: "tesham shomron" (Hoshea 13:16), veomer: "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha" kidita besifri befarashat vayyeshev yisrael bashshittim:

Ad Adonai elohecha. tane beshem rabbi meir (Pesikta derav kahana kad,13): shuva yisrael beod shehu Adonai bemiddat harachamim, veim lav – elohecha middat haddin, ad dela yitaved sannegorya kattegorya:
Ki chashalta. bau lecha michsholim bead avonecha:
targum: Tuv yisrael lidchalta dayya elahach are itkalta bechovach:

rashi: Vayyichtov moshe, vayyittenah. keshennigmera kullah netanah livne shivto (80 sifre Devarim 34):
Channeni Adonai. atta baggola:
Merommi. bigullatcha:
targum: Chus alay Adonai chame sigufi mibbaale devavi meromem li mimaalane mota:

ohc: Adonai elohecha hu vegomer hu yashmid vegomer. hutzrach lomar shene peamim "hu" velo hispik beachat. nitkavven lenachamam al petirato, vaasher yechseru shene devarim gedolim vetovim: haachat, ki haya lahem lemagen lifne Adonai levilti kallotam kemo shemmatzinu baegel uvammeraggelim, lule moshe bechiro. shenit, ki hu ibbed veshibber shene malche haemori sichon veog, umi yakum bimkomo lilchom hammilchamot haggedolot asher hem meuttadim lifnehem?

Laze amar, keneged ma shennogea laAdonai amar "Adonai elohecha hu over lefanecha", al derech amro (Shemot 17:5) "avor lifne haam", perush, ki hu haover al pishachem veelav tachaziku hattov velo li, kemo shekken matzinu shehu heir et ruach moshe lehitpallel alehem bemaase haegel, dichtiv (Shemot 32:10) "hannicha li" vegomer, veen beheder moshe heder haavarat al pesha ki hu yaavor lefanecha.
Ucheneged gevurat hammilchama amar, ki lo kocho shel moshe hu haose chayil, ella Adonai hu hallochem, vehu amro "hu yashmid" vegomer, uletzad haemtzaiyyut amar "yehoshua hu over lefanecha":

Vedikdek lomar "hu", yitbaer al derech ma sheamar hannavi bemilchemet haay, keshennafal miyyisrael kishloshim veshishsha ish venafal yehoshua al panav, amar elav Adonai "kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al panecha" (yehoshua 7:10), veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 44.) sheamar Adonai elav: "atta garamta, shello yatzata immahem", vehu ma sheamar moshe "hu over", perush, haddavar taluy sheyyaavor hu beatzmo lefanecha velo shelucho.

rashi: Erpa meshuvatam. amar hannavi: kach amar li ruach hakkodesh, meachar sheyyomru lefanay ken, erpa meshuvatam veohavem benidvat ruchi, af al pi sheenan reuyin leahava, etnaddev leahavatam, ki shav appi mimmennu (tanchuma, ekev 4):
targum: Akabbelinun bityuvethon eshvok lechovehon arachaminun kad yetuvun bindava are tav rugezi minhon:

rashi: Ashshur lo yoshienu. od zot amru lefanav: lo nevakkesh od ezrat adam, lo meashshur velo mimmitzrayim:
Al sus lo nirkav. zo hi ezrat mitzrayim, shehayu sholchim lahem susim, kemo sheamru lishaya (yeshaya 30:16) "lo chi al sus nanus veal kal nirkav": velo nomar od:
Lemaase yadenu. shehem elohenu:
Asher becha. levaddecha tihye tikvatenu, hamerachem yetomim:
targum: Malche attur la yifrekinana al rachve susevan la nitrechetz vela nomar od elahana leovade yedana demin kodamach itrachem al avahtana kad havo vemitzrayim ha keyatmin:

ohc: Veanochi haseter astir. kashe lamma yastir panav achare shehitvaddu et chattatam veamru "halo al ki en elohay bekirbi", veim noten hakkatuv taam lema sheavar ad atta shehistir panav mehem, ze eno tzarich leamro, ki roe ani shehattaam shehistir hu lefi shezzanu achare elohe nechar kemo sheamar lemala. od yesh lehair bappasuk lamma kafal "haseter astir". od tzarich ladaat lamma heerich lashon lomar "al kol haraa" vechazar lefaresh "ki fana".

Achen hakkatuv ba latet taam lehasetarat panim, ki yomar haomer chas veshalom she lo shafat betzedek chas veshalom mishpat ze, ki amar hannavi (yeshaya 27,8) "besassea beshalchah" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sota 8:) bemidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo, vehu yishpot betzedek el emuna veen avel.

Vehinne behasetarat pene Adonai mehem, yachol lihyot sheyyihyu nifraim al chattatam yoter mishshiur harauy lahem lefi ansham, ki en hashshofet chafetz ladaat et asher yavo alehem mehatztzarot veharaot, veen ze mishpat tzedek chas veshalom, veulay ki ze kalul bemaamar sheomrim "halo al ki en elohay bekirbi metzauni" vegomer:

Uva hakkatuv lehashiv teshuva nechona, veamar "veanochi haseter", perush, hasetara zo yesh li baddin sheastir panay mehem, velaze kafal "haseter astir bayyom hahu", perush, bayyom shezzana achare elohe nechar. veamar hattaam "al kol haraa asher" vegomer, perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (sifre raa 11,25; chullin 5.) kol hammode baavoda zara kechofer bechol hattora kullah, vehu amro shettaam hahastara hu "al kol haraa asher asa", uma hu – "ki fana el elohim acherim". umeatta hagam sheyyavou alav kol hatztzarot shebbaolam mechamat hasetarat panim, rauy hu laze keshem shehu asa kol haraa, yavou alav kol hatztzarot, vechach shurat haddin notenet.

Veda ki en tzara veen raa baolam sheenah keneged avera achat, ki Adonai yasad yissurin keneged kol hachataim, kederech shekkava sachar keneged kol maase hattov, vechevan shekken adam sheavar al kol hattora kullah, o al avoda zara sheshshekula kechol hattora, onesh hu lavo alav kol onoshin shebbaolam, velaze histir Adonai panav mehem:

Vayyelech moshe. tzarich ladaat lehechan halach, veyonatan tirgem shehalach lemishkan bet ulefana, vehammefarshim amru (ayyen 292 verabbenu bechayye) shehalach mimmachane leviyya lemachane yisrael keadam hanniftar mechavero, vehakkatuv satum hu, veen mimmennu hekker leechad mehadderachim. od tzarich ladaat mi heir et ruach moshe ladaat shemmalu yamav ushenotav, vahalo amru baggemara (shabbat 30.) sheen modiin laadam yamav ushenotav, umi hodio lemoshe?

Venire lefaresh al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (Zohar hakkadosh chelek 1 218.) sheamru ki arbaim yom kodem happetira nishmat haadam holechet mimmennu, keamro (Shir HaShirim 4:6) "venasu hatztzelalim", umevakkeret mekom chanayyatah bemakom elyon, vehatztzaddikim yakkiru baddavar, vetze ulemad merabbi shimon bar yochay shehikkir berabbi yitzchak kaamur besefer hazzohar (sham).

Veamru od ki hashshemot sheyyesh leyisrael hem shemot hanneshamot. uchevar hairoti baze beferush pasuk "veshem reshaim yirkav" (Mishlei 10:7), uchemaamar chachamenu zichronam livracha sheamru (Zohar chodesh Rut 84,3) sheen harshaim zochrim et shemam. vehattaam hu ki harasha en lo nefesh, uchemo sheramuz bappasuk "vesamta sakkin beloecha im baal nefesh atta" (Mishlei 23:2), ha lamadta sheharasha eno baal nefesh, ki nishbet hi mimmennu, velaze en harshaim makkirim et shemam, ki enam baale nefesh baalat hashshem.

Vechan amar "vayyelech moshe", perush ruach hachayyim shebbo shettikkare moshe, halcha kasseder haragil lemi shemmaggia kitztzo. vechinna lenafsho leshon zachar, ki hu siman legodel hannefesh keshettihye bemadregat zachar. vehodia hakkatuv bema sheamar "vaydabber et" vegomer, shehirgish bahalichatah vehikkir shehiggia kitztzo bayyom hahu, keamro "ben mea vegomer anochi hayyom", veamru zichronam livracha (sota 13:) hayyom malu yamay ushenotay.

Veim tomar: minnayin yada moshe bediyyuk yom hammita? halo amru zichronam livracha ki miyyom sheyyanusu hatztzelalim ad yom hammita hem arbaim yom, umi yodea haddevarim yoter mimmoshe, vehiskil veyada yom kitztzo, vehakkara kazo musseget hi ligdole olam, veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk "vayyikrevu yeme yisrael" (Bereshit 47:29):

Vaydabber et (kol) haddevarim vegomer. amro "et (kol) haddevarim", lehair shehagam shehiggia yom petirato, keamro "anochi hayyom", perush hayyom malu yamay vegomer, af al pi chen haya bo koach hayyachol dabber kol haddevarim hanneemarim mikkan vead sof hassefer, ma sheen koach bezulato asot ken, ben bakkoach haggufiyyi ben bechoach hassechel.

rashi: Ki kaasher yered haggeshem vehashsheleg. vlo yashuv rekam, ach yetiv laolam:
targum: Are kema denachet mitra vetalga min shemaya uletaman la efshar leh dituv elahen merave yat ara umarbe lah umoilah veyahav bar zara kemisat lezarea velachma kemisat lemechol:

rashi: Yelchu yonkotav. "yisgon benin uvenan, vihi keziv menarta dekudesha zivhon verechahon kereach ketoret busemayya":
Kallevanon. kevet makdesha:
targum: Yisgun benin uvenan vihe cheziv menarat kudesha zivhon verichahon kereach ketoret busemaya:

rashi: Veniatzuni. vehichisuni, vechen kol niutz leshon kaas:
Yehemu yechmeru memav. yegarshu refesh vechomer vatit (Yeshayahu 57:20) kemishpatam, umenachem chibbero kemo "meay chomarmaru", (Eicha 1:20) 681 belaaz:
Yirashu harim begaavato. shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shennizkar berosh hammizmor (tehillim 46:2):
targum: Mitragshin mitashteshin mohi min afarhon mitragfin turaya begevtanutach lealmin:

rashi: Vehu yishpot tevel betzedek yadin leummim bemesharim. ad bo hakketz haya ragil leshaftam berachamim, lefi mesharim hametzuvin bahem. dan otam ballayla, keshehem yeshenim min haaverot:
targum: Vehu yeden ama deara bizchuta yedin ammaya bitritzuta:

rashi: Achare moti ki hashechet tashechaytaven. vahare kol yemot yehoshua lo hishchitu, shenneemar "vayyaavdu haam et Adonai kol yeme yehoshua" (Shoftim 2)? mikkan shettalmido shel adam chaviv alav kegufo, kol zeman sheyyehoshua chay haya nire lemoshe keillu hu chay:
Vaytzav et yehoshua bin nun. musav lemala kelappe shechina, kemo shemmeforash "el haaretz asher nishbati lahem":
Lechol haammim. velo leyisrael levaddam, ki af laggerim:
targum: Veaytinun letura dekudeshi veachadinun bevet tzeloti alvathon venichsat kudeshehon yittaskun leraava al madbechi are vet makdeshi vet tzelo yitkere lechol ammaya:
Haefshar di lealmin yirchak Adonai vela yosif leitraaya tuv:
Yashbik rashia orche derisha ugevar anes eshtonohi vituv lefulechana dayya virachem alohi velidchalta deelahana are masge lesalacha:
Kidnan amar Adonai taru dina avidu tzidkata are kariv purekani lemete uzechuti leitgelaa:
Rechuvay ittekalu mitzoma uvisri patren milheve patim:
Vaana haveti kelana lehon yechmun yati yetaltelun reshehon:
Veetten lehon bevet makdeshi uvaara bet shechinti atar veshum detav mibbenin umibbenan shum alam etten lehon dela yifsok:
Veyedun arum mechatach da ant Adonai avadtah:
Veyistakkelun besabbarutach yade shemach metul dela shevakta tavayich Adonai:
Uvene ammaya demittosfin al ame dayya leshamashute ulemircham yat shema dayya lemeheve leh leavdin kol deyitar shabbeta leachalute umatkefin bikyami:
Yelattun hinun veat tevarech yekumun veyivahatun veavdach yechde:
Seod li Adonai elohay perok yati hech chasdach:

bart: Masmer sheachar hakkikkar. batzek habbolet min hakkikkar shel lechem kemin masmer, veyesh sheosin oto kach lesiman:
Vegarger melach katan. shennidbak bakkikkar veneefa immo:
Vehacharchur. shennisraf hallechem pachot meovi etzba sevivotav. charchur, leshon nachar mappuach meesh (yirmeya 6):
Rabbi yose omer. kol shehassaruf neechol im hakkikkar, have chibbur. veim naga tevul yom bassaruf keillu naga bappat, vei lo, lo have chibbur. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Shennagas. shemmehappech haochel befiv. leshon megis bakkedera:
Venafal. haochel im lachluchit harok shebbo, al begadav veal kikkar shel teruma:
Tahor. hakkikkar, kelomar lo huchshar lekabbel tuma. veaf al gav derok bealma machshir, shane hacha delo achsheveh larok veeno leratzon, shehare nafal al begadav, ufeshita delo nicha leh:

Kol shehu rotze lamotz et garinato. im nitkavven limtzotz hallachut shebbaggarin, venafal haggarin im harok shebbo al kikkar shel teruma, huchshar hakkikkar barok sheal gabbe haggarin, deha achsheveh:
Zetim neguvin utemarim yeveshot kol sheeno rotze lamotz garinato. lo huchshav hammashke hahu veeno machshir:
Echad tahor veechad tevul yom kaelu. kelomar shenehem shavin bedin ze:
Rabbi meir omer ellu vaellu. ben retubbot ben yeveshot:
Temeim bitvul yom. kedimfaresh taama, demashkin shel tame machshirim umetammein afillu shello leratzon, utevul yom ketame ledin ze. verabbanan chashve leh litvul yom ketahor. vahalacha kachachamim:

En dorshin baarayot. lishlosha bene adam keechad en dorshin lahem sitre arayot, kegon bitto meanusato delo ketiva bikra behedya veatya midderasha. shemma bizman shemmedabber harav im echad yisseu veyittenu hashshenayim benehem, velo yittenu libbam lishmoa mippi harav kesheddarash bo issur, veyavou lehakel baarayot al yede shennafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammadtan yoter mishshear issurim shebbattora:

Velo vemaase vereshit. bemaase sheshet yeme bereshit afillu lishne bene adam, vechol shekken lishlosha o yoter, deamar kera (Devarim 4) ki sheal na leyamim rishonim, yachid shoel veen shenayim shoalim:

Velo bemaase merkava. sheraa yechezkel vesheraa yeshaya. verambam peresh, maase vereshit, hachachma hattivit. umaase merkava, metziut hael utearav vehammalachim vehannefesh vehassechel, uma sheyyihye achar hammavet. veen nire li sheyyikkare kol ze maase merkava, deim ken chachmat hammerkava hava leh lemitne, ella maase merkava hu sheal yede hazekarat shemot shel kedushsha mishtammeshim bakketer, vetzofin ech mishmerot hammalachim bemaamadan veech hechol lifnim mehechol, keen hassochin beruach hakkodesh:
Beyachid ella im ken haya chacham umevin middato. afillu leadam echad en dorshin bammerkava, ella im ken makkir bo harav shehu chacham sheim yimsor lo rashe perakim yihye hu mevin hashshear middato:
Kol hammistakkel bearbaa devarim. hane dimfaresh veazel:
Rauy lo. yafe vetov haya lo im lo ba leolam:
Ma lemala. merashe hachayyot:
Ma lematta. mittachat laaretz:
Ma lefanim. chutz limchitztzat harakia bammizrach:
Uma leachor. lemaarav. perush acher, ma lefanim kodem shennivra haolam, ma leachor besof haolam leacharit hayyamim:
Vechol shello chas al kevod kono. sheover avera basseter veomer en shechina metzuya kan umi roeni umi yodeni:

Hattoda. chamesh sein yerushalmiyyot shehen shesh midbariyyot. chamesh sein shel yerushalayim hen shesh meotan shehayu bammidbar bime moshe. shehosifu al hammidda shehayta bime moshe shetut. dekayma lan mosifin al hammiddot veen mosifin yoter mishshetut. veoto shetut hu shetut millevar:
Shete efot. kelomar, hanach shesh sein hem shete efot, shehem esrim issaron, shehare bechol efa asara esronot:
Asara lechametz. asara esronim leeser challot chametz shebbattoda:
Revucha. chaluta bemayim rotchin keruya revucha. verambam peresh revucha, merubba beshemen ukeluya bo, lefi shehaya bah shemen keneged hachallot veharkikin:
Nimtzeu shelosha esronot ushelish lechol min vamin. shebbammatztza:
Shalosh challot leissaron. dahava lehu eser challot lishlosha esronot ushelish:

Bemidda yerushalmit. shello hayu bah esronot ella kabbim, have hanach chamesh sein sheloshim kabbin. shehassea shishsha kabbim. uvaggemara babberayta mayte miggezera shava shekkol min vamin mearbaa minim shebbattoda hayu baim eser challot, veamru, neemar kan vehikriv mimmennu echad mikkol karban teruma laAdonai, veneemar bitrumat maaser [mimmennu] teruma laAdonai, ma lehallan echad meeser af kan echad meeser. velamadnu shemmin echad shel chametz haya asara esronim keneged shelosha minim shel matztza, middichtiv (Vayikra 7) al challot lechem chametz, amra tora keneged chametz have matztza:

Hammashkim pesulim. ditvul yom posel et hatteruma bilvad, vetammoye lo metamme vaafillu mashkin, dechol happosel et hatteruma metamme mashkin lihyot techilla chutz min hattevul yom. hilkach, hakkedera tehora, demashkin shennagu bitvul yom afillu ochalim lo metammee, vechol shekken kelim:
Veim haya mashke chullin hakkol tahor. ditvul yom tahor lechullin ulemaaser:
Veim hayu yadav mesoavot hakkol tame. deyadayim poslot et hatteruma, ucheshennitmeu hammashkim mechamat yadayim chazru lihyot techilla umetammein kelim:
Shessefek tevul yom posel et hatteruma. kegon shete kikkarot lefanav, safek naga safek lo naga, bichhay gavna bayyadayim tahor, uvitvul yom pasul:
Hannaasot bichli. kegon minchat marcheshet umachavat shehen naasot bichli:
Teunot shalosh mattenot shemen. lemaote minchat maafe tannur sheenah teuna yetzika:

Umattan shemen bakkeli kodem laasiyyatan. techilla noten shemen bichli sharet venoten solet alav, dichtiv beminchat marcheshet (Vayikra 2) solet bashshemen tease, kelomar tinnaten, alma dituna mattan shemen kodem laasiyyatah, uveminchat machavat ketiv belila vitzika velo ketiv bah mattan shemen bakkeli techilla, uvammarcheshet ketiv mattan shemen velo ketiv bah yetzika uvelila. vegamrinan hach mehach, neemar karbancha bamarcheshet veneemar karbancha bammachavat. vechetzad hu ose, noten shemen techilla bichli sharet, venoten alav et hassolet, [vechozer] venoten aleha shemen uvollan, hare mattan shemen bakkeli uvelila, velashah bemayim veofah battannur ufottah veyotzek aleha shemen achar petita, vezo hi yetzika, hare shelashtan. vekometz umaktir et hakkometz, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim:

Vehachallot bollan divre rabbi. hasheta mayre beminchat maafe tannur shehi baa challot o rekikim, uchetiv bah (sham) solet challot matztzot belulot bashshemen. rabbi savar challot belulot ketiv, shebbollan keshehen challot. verabbanan savre solet belula ketiv, melammed shennivlelet keshehi solet. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hachallot teunot belila veharkikim meshuchim. dichtiv challot belulot, velo rekikim belulim. rekikim meshuchim, velo challot meshuchot:
Ketzad moshchan kemin chi. yevanit, shehi kemin 9‏ shellanu, kehaferashat gudal [shel semol] min haetzba [kaze c ]:
Yom tevoach. yom shechitat olot reiyya shel yom tov leachar hashshabbat, sheen kerevim lo beyom tov velo beshabbat, vaatzeret yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva kefesach vesukkot:

Uvet hillel omrim en lah yom tevoach. enah tzericha yom tevoach, shemmuttar lehakerivan beyom tov. uvet hillel letaamayyhu deamre meviin shelamim veolot beyom tov. veashmeinan tanna daafillu hecha delo efshar lemeavad lemachar, kegon dechal atzeret beerev shabbat, afillu beha amre bet shammay deen olat reiyya kereva beyom tov vedachu lah ad leachar hashshabbat:
En kohen gadol mitlabbesh bechelav. bechelim naim shello, beyom tevoach shel atzeret sheachar hashshabbat, kede shello yitnae beoto hayyom, sheyyavinu hakkol sheen hayyom yom tov:

Shello lekayyem divre haomrim atzeret achar shabbat. shehayu hatztzedokim omrim leolam atzeret achar shabbat, dichtiv (Vayikra 23) usefartem lachem mimmochorat hashshabbat, vehen omrim mimmochorat shabbat bereshit veim ken leolam chal atzeret beechad beshabbat:
Midras. av hattuma letamme adam vechelim kemidras hazzav shemmetamme adam vechelim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 15) vechol asher yigga bemishkavah yechabbes begadav:
Lapperushim. leochle chullehem betohorat chullin:

Bigde ferushim midras leochle teruma. kan chaser maala achat, vehachi ibbae leh lemitne, bigde perushim midras leochle maaser sheni, bigde ochle maaser sheni midras leochle teruma, dehaynu lakkohanim bitrumatan. vechol hane maalot middivre sofrim ninhu, sheamru en shemirat tohoratan shel ellu chashuva shemira etzel ellu. umittoch shehen etzel ellu keillu lo shemarum, gazru bevigdehem shemma yashva alehem ishto nidda, vahare hen midras hannidda:
Haya ochel al tohorat hakkodesh. haya ochel chullin shello betohora keillu haya kodesh, shehaya nizhar bahen mikkol tuma hametamme et hakkodesh:

Vehayta mitpachto midras lachattat. aval lo lakkodesh. diksavar hay tanna chullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh kekodesh damu. veen ken halacha, dechullin shennaasu al tohorat hakkodesh lav kekodesh damu lechol haddevarim, kidita besof massechet nidda:

Shesh arayot chamurot meellu. uma hi chumra shellahen, shennesuot laacherim, veenan yecholot lehinnase leachiv shel ze meaviv, veim metu baalehen shehen nachrim etzel ze, tzarotehen muttarot linnase laze, sheen tzarat erva asura ella benofelet lefanav leyibbum meachiv. verabbenu moshe bar maymon peresh, im nisseu baavera leachiv, umet belo vanim venaflu leyibbum lefanav, tzarotehen muttarot, sheen ellu tzarot erva, hoil velo hayu kiddushin tofsin leachiv beotan arayot:

Immo. enah yechola lehinnase leachiv meaviv, shehare hi lo eshet haav, ledivre haomer sheanusat aviv asura. uleel perashti sheen ken halacha, ella immo poteret tzaratah, shehi yechola lehinnase leachiv meaviv:

Eshet aviv, eshet achiv meaviv. [shehaya lo banim] vaachot aviv, kullan asurot leachiv kemo sheasurot alav, veen bahem tzad yibbum al ze leolam. veim nesaum acherim velahem nashim acherot umetu, tzarotehen muttarot linnase laze. vechen im nasa otah achiv baavera umet belo vanim, tzarotehen muttarot:
Lefas. kemo ilpas, keen machavat sheosin bah hattavshil. uvetza zo mitbashshelet im hatteruma shennifsela bitvul yom:
Min hassafa. shel ilpas velifnim. chashuv hachut shel betza chibbur, veim naga sham tevul yom, hakkol tame. aval hachut hayyotze missefat hailpas velachutz lo have chibbur:
Vechol shenniklaf immo. hayenu ma sheole im hachut, have chibbur velo yoter. rabbi yose lekulla. vehachi muchach battosefta. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Vechen bekitniyyot. dinam kedin habbetza:
Marcheshet amukka. dichtiv (Vayikra 7) vechol naasa vammarcheshet, betochah mashma, alma yesh lah toch:
Umaaseha rochashin. shehashshemen na vanad betochah. leshon haromes al haaretz dimtargeminan derachesh. veyesh sheggorsin umaaseha rakkin, kelomar shellishatah rakka:
Umachavat tzafa. dichtiv (sham) al machavat, mashma aleha velo betochah, alma en lah toch:
Tzafa. sheenah amukka ella shuleha tzafin etzel ogneha. kemo tzaf al pene hammayim:
Umaaseha kashim. shehaissa shemmetaggenim bah lishatah kasha kede shello tishshafech lachutz, shehare hakkeli en lo safa:
Kol yedot hoochalim. hookatzim shehaochel nitle bahen kesherotzin litloto, veadam ochez bo kesherotze leechol happeri:
Shehem chibbur beav hattuma. sheim av hattuma naga bahen keillu naga bapperi atzmo:
Chibbur bitvul yom. im hu yad leferot shel teruma, venaga tevul yom beoto hayyad, nifselu happerot shel teruma:
Shennifras. leshon perusa. veit degarse shennifram, leshon uvegadav lo yifrom (Vayikra 21):
Umeore. mechubbar:
Im ochez baggadol bapperusa haggedola, vehapperusa hakketanna ola immah veenah nifseket mikkol vachol:
Hare hu chamohu. im naga tevul yom beechad, nifsal hashsheni:
Rabbi nechemya omer battahor. kelomar, beoto shello naga bo tevul yom meshaarin, ben shehu gadol ben shehu katan, im ochez bo vehattame ole immo, shenehem temeim:
Vachachamim omrim battame. meshaarin, im ochez battame vehattahor ole immo. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ushear kol hoochalim. kegon mine yerakot:

Et sheddarko leachez beale. keshebba letaltelo, ochazim oto beale, veim lo yippasek hayyarak veyippol kesheochazim oto beale, have chibbur, vei lo, lo have chibbur, ben im naga tevul yom beale ben naga bayyarak atzmo:
Chavitte chohen gadol. minchat kohen gadol shemmevi bechol yom. veal shem dichtiv bah (Vayikra 6) al machavat bashshemen tease, mishshum hachi kare lah chavittin:
Lo hayu vaot chatzain. shello yavi mibbeto chatzi issaron babboker vachatzi issaron baerev:
Velo chatzi esrono shel rishon. shennishar min haissaron shalem shehevi harishon shemmet velo karav ella chetzyo:
Ushene chatzayin ovdim. chatzi esrono shel rishon shemmet vachatzi esrono shel ze sheamad:
Mishshel tzibbur. dichtiv chak olam, chok ze yehe mishshel olam, kelomar mishshel tzibbur mitterumat hallishka:
Rabbi yehuda omer mishshel yorshim. dichtiv (sham) vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav. vehachi mashma, vehakkohen hammashiach shemmet, tachtav echad mibbanav yaase otah:

Ushelema hayta kereva. kol zeman shehi baa mishshel tzibbur lerabbi shimon o mishshel yorshim lerabbi yehuda, shelema hayta kereva, issaron shalem velo chatzi issaron. rabbi shimon mappik leh mikkalil taktar, shello yaktiruha lachatzaim ella kullah keshehi baa mishshel tzibbur. verabbi yehuda mappik la middichtiv mibbanav yaase otah, kesheechad mibbanav makriv leachar shemmet aviv dehaynu hayyorshim, yaase otah velo chetzyah. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda shemmishshel yorshim hi baa:
Chavit sheshshaka. chavit shel yayin shel teruma shennafla letoch habbor, veshaka betoch hayyayin shebbabbor, vehayyayin shebbabbor chullin, vetzaf lemala al pi hechavit:

Venaga vechulei. im shilshel yado letoch pi hechavit min hassafa velifnim hare ze chibbur, venifsal kol hayyayin shebbechavit, vaafillu lo hayta hechavit mittechillatah melea legamre min hayyayin shel teruma:
Min hassafa velachutz. shello hichnis yado letoch pi hechavit, af al pi shennaga bayyayin shel bor shekkeneged pi hechavit, afillu hachi eno chibbur:
Afillu al gabbah rum koma. sheala yayin shebbabbor al pene hechavit rum komat adam, im naga keneged piha have chibbur. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:

Chamesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen. sheim hayta achat mehen nesua leachiv velo shete nashim umet belo vanim, shetehen peturot, shenneemar (Vayikra 18) veishsha el achotah lo tikkach litzror legallot ervatah aleha, sheen talmud lomar aleha, ella lelammedcha sheafillu yevimto shenneemar bah (Devarim 25) yevamah yavo aleha, im hi ishsha el achotah, lo tikkach. vehu haddin lishar arayot sheyyesh bahen karet. veen li ella hi, tzaratah minnayin, talmud lomar litzor. tzarat tzaratah minnayin, talmud lomar litzror. demashma lo tikkach lo hi velo tzaratah velo tzarat tzaratah:

Bitto uvat bitto vechulei. bevitto meanusato, vechen bat bitto uvat beno, deillu bitto meishto hayenu bat ishto. dechevan dichtiv (Vayikra 18) ervat ishsha uvittah, lo shena hemennu velo shena meish acher. aval bitto meanusato lo nafek mehay kera, deishsha al yede kiddushin mashma, ella nafka meervat bat bincha o bat bittecha (sham):
Chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv. kol ellu asurot lo mishshum ervat ishsha uvittah lo tegalle et bat benah veet bat bittah, veyesh bichlal ze chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv:

Achoto meimmo. shennisset leachiv meaviv umet. vechen achot immo. sheen yibbum ella beachiv min haav, deyalfinan achava achava mibbene yaakov, ma lehallan min haav af al pi sheen min haem, hacha nammi lo shena:

Veeshet achiv meimmo. shemmet unesaah achiv meaviv, shehayta nachrit etzlo, umet belo vanim venafla lefanav leyibbum. vaasura lo lefi shehayta techilla eshet achiv meimmo vaasura lo olamit, dichtiv (sham) ervat eshet achicha, vedarshinan achicha ben min haav ben min haem:

Veeshet achiv shello haya veolamo. kegon reuven shemmet belo vanim, venolad lo ach leachar mita ushemo levi, veyibbem shimon et ishto velo ishsha acheret, umet belo vanim, venaflu shetehen lifne levi, shetehen peturot, lefi sheeshet reuven shennisset leshimon asura lelevi becharet, lefi shemmiatah hakkatuv miyyibbum levi, shenneemar (Devarim 25) ki yeshvu achim yachdav, shehayta lahem yeshiva achat baolam. hilkach keshemmet reuven, neesra al levi issur olam keeshet ach sheyyesh lo banim. veaf al pi sheatta nafla mikkoach nissue shimon shehaya beolamo, asura lo mechamat reuven. ucheshem shehi asura, kach tzaratah asura:
Vechallato. shemmet beno, unesaah achiv. vechallato asura alav issur olam vaafillu achar shemmet beno:

Vechullan im metu. kegon shemmeta bitto kodem mitat achiv o shemmeana bo. veaf al pi sheen meun ella bitoma ketanna shehissiuha immah veacheha, mashkachat lah shemmeana bechayye aviha, kegon shehissiah aviha leacher venitgarsha beodah ketanna, sheshshuv en leaviha reshut bah, venisset laachi aviha beodah ketanna, az yotza bemeun, dekarinan lah lekamman yetoma bechayye haav. veim meana beachiv o nitgarsha mimmennu, o nimtzea aylonit shemmikchah mekkach taut ucheillu lo hayta eshet achiv meolam, tzaratah mityabbemet:

Aylonit. leshon ayil, hazzachar min hatztzon. vesimaneha meforashim, sheen lah shadayim kenashim, veen lah simanim, vekolah ave keish, veen lah shippule meayim kenashim, kelomar sheoto makom eno bolet miggufah keervat shear hannashim:

Vei atta yachol lomar vechulei. shekkevar yaldu meacher kodem shennisseu leachiv, hilkach lav ayloniyyot ninhu. umeun nammi lekka, shehare gedolot hen, veen memaenet ella ketanna. vetanna didan delo chashiv immo bichlal hannashim sheppotrot tzarotehen, savar lah keman deamar sheen adam nose anusat aviv umefuttat aviv. aval ledivre haomer nose adam anusat aviv umefuttat aviv, vehi halacha, efshar shettinnase immo leachiv meaviv, uchesheyyamut belo vanim nimtzet immo nofelet lifne benah leyibbum, venimtzeu shesh esre nashim potrot tzarotehen, veimmo achat mehen. vechen halacha:

Baze yafe choach hammizbeach. lo have tzarich lemitne, deha chazinan devaze yafe koach hammizbeach umilleta difshita hi. ella laatoye hammitnaddev yayin lammizbeach belo karban, delo tema mezallefo al haishshim al haesh vehu nisraf vechale veen koach mizbeach yafe baze, ka mashma lan delo, ella menassecho kishar nesachim veyored lashshitin dehaynu kemin shene nekavim shehayu bammizbeach veyordim lematta ad hayesod, kede sheyyihye koach hammizbeach yafe:

Uvaze yafe choach hakkohanim. laatoye shete hallechem shel atzeret im hevium bifne atzman belo kevasim, delo tema lisrefa omdot velo laachila kevan shello karvu kevasim shemmattirim otam, kamashma lan devaze yafe koach kohanim leolam, delaachila omdot velo lisrefa:
Yarak shel teruma. shennittenu bikara o veilpas:
Uvetza terufa bakkeara. shennitarev hachelbon vehachelmon yachad, unetuna al gabbe hayyarak:

Venaga tevul yom babbetza. af al pi shehi chullin, deen shayyach teruma bevetza, utevul yom eno posel bechullin. afillu hachi have chibbur, venifsal hayyarak keillu naga bo. umihu lo fasal ella hakkelach shekkeneged magga yado, ushear hakkelachim tehorim:
Kol hasseder haelyon. kelachim haelyonim shehabbetza al penehem. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Im haya chemin kova. shemmechamat habbishshul nitnappecha habbetza venaaset kemin kova al hayyarak vachalula tachteha:

Shenneemar kol hammincha asher takrivu laAdonai‏ lo tease chametz. aresha kae dekatane umishtammerot shello yachmitzu, vekodem kemitza mishtae. usheyareha yalfinan mikkera acharina dichtiv (sham 6) lo teafe chametz chelkam, af chelkam shel kohanim shehem sheyare hammincha shennisharu min hakkometz, af zo lo teafe chametz. uvechametz davka huzharu al hashshirayim, aval muttar lalush otam bidvash uletaggenan bo:

Arichatah. shemmitassek bah bayyadayim achar lisha. vechayyavin al kol achat veachat, lefi shenneemar lo tease chametz, yachol lo yehe chayyav ella achat, talmud lomar lo teafe, afiyya bichlal hayta velamma yatzat, lehakish eleha, ma afiyya meyuchedet shehi maase yechidi vechayyavin aleha bifne atzmah, af ani avi lishatah vaarichatah vechol maase yechidi shebbah, laatoye kittuf shehu maase yechidi vechayyavin aleha bifne atzmah. vekittuf hu shemmachalik paneha bemayim, veaf al gav delo mechaze kol kach maase:
Pasal et kullo. kasavar shemen machshir umechabber:
Lo fasal ella mekom maggao. deshemen eno mechabber, vekae kol kelach vekelach beappe nafsheh:

Veomrin lahem. leamme haaretz baregel: hizzaharu shello tiggeu bashshulchan. lefi shello yuchelu lehatebilo leachar haregel, shei efshar lesalleko mimmekomo, dichtiv beh (Shemot 28) lechem panim lefanay tamid:
Teunim tevila. mippene tumat haregel:

Chutz mimmizbach hazzahav umizbach hannechoshet mippene shehen kakkarka. mizbach hannechoshet shehattora keraattu (Shemot 20) mizbach adama. umizbach hazzahav ketiv (Bamidbar 3) hammenora vehammizbechot, ittakkash mizbechot ze leze. veshulchan ha amran delo nagu bo:

Mippene shehen metzuppin. hachi kaamar, vachachamim metammein veomrin shetztzerichin tevila gam hem mippene shehen metzuppin, dei lo havu metzuppin yesh letaharan mishshum kele etz haasuyin lenachat. perush acher vachachamim omrim detaama deen tzerichin tevila lefi shehem metzuppin zahav unechoshet vetzippuyan batil legabbehen, vahavu kichle etz haasuyin lenachat sheenan metammein, velo pelige al rabbi eliezer ella betaama demilta bilvad, kach peresh harambam behilchot metammee mishkav umoshav:
Chomer bakkodesh. shemmatbilin keli betoch keli. kesheshshenehem temeim:

Aval lo lakkodesh. deamrinan kavdo shel keli happenimi hammachbid al hachitzon shehu munnach betocho, chotzetz bifne hattuma (tzarich lomar bifne hammayim, vechen hu 512 baggemara) veen tevila ola lo leze velo leze:

Achorayim vetoch uvet hatztzevita latteruma. keli harauy lehishtammesh betocho uvaachorav uvet tzevitato, kol tashmish vetashmish shebbo, chashuv keli bifne atzmo leinyan teruma, sheim nitma ze lo nitma ze. uvetumot derabbanan kaamar, sheim nitmeu achorav bemashkim temeim lo nitma tocho velo bet tzevitato, veim nitma bet tzevitato lo nitmeu achorav vetocho. uferush bet hatztzevita, bet achiza, leshon vayyitzbat lah kali (Rut 2). veit degarse bet hatztzevia, leshon etzba, sheosin lakkeli bet achiza lehachenis etzbao betocho keshehu shote, kede shello yachnis yado letoch hakkeli:
Aval lo lakkodesh. sheim nitma echad mehem betumot derabbanan, kullo tame lakkodesh:
Hannose et hammidras. minal shel zav:
Nose et hatteruma. im yirtze, bechavit shel cheres, sheeno nogea baavirah:

Aval lo et hakkodesh. mishshum maase shehaya beadam echad shehaya nose chavit yayin shel nesachim venifseka lo retzua shel sandal shehaya midras hazzav, unetalah beyado, umittoch kach nafla laavir hechavit venitma hakkodesh. beotah shaa amru hannose et hammidras lo yissa et hakkodesh. ulefi shemmaase shehaya bakkodesh haya, lefichach lo gazru ella bakkodesh velo batteruma:
Lo chemiddat hakkodesh. bachatzitzat tevilotav, middat hatteruma:
Shebbakkodesh. im yesh beged tame uva lehatebilo, im kashur hu mattir et kishro, mishshum dedami lachatzitza:
Umenaggev. im lach hu menaggevo techilla, deshamnunit shealav have kechotzetz:
Uvatteruma. im yirtze koshro veachar kach matbil keshehu kashur veen bechach kelum:

Sheniyyot. laarayot. sheggazru sofrim alehem. venikreu issur mitzva, shemmitzva lishmoa divre chachamim. veellu hen, em immo veen lah hefsek, veem avi immo bilvad, veem aviv veen lah hefsek, [veem avi aviv], veeshet avi aviv veen lah hefsek, veeshet avi immo bilvad, veeshet achi haav min haem, veeshet achi haem ben min haem ben min haav, vechallat beno veen lah hefsek, vechallat bitto, uvat bat beno, uvat bat bitto, uvat ben beno, uvat ben bitto, uvat bat ben ishto, uvat bat bat ishto, veem em avi ishto, veem em em ishto, veem av em ishto, veem av avi ishto:
Almana lechohen gadol. shemmet achiv hahedyot venafla ishto lefanav:

Gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot. kegon sheavar achiv hammet venasa gerusha vachalutza, ucheshemmet tzericha chalitza, shehare tafsu lo bah kiddushin mishshum dekiddushin tofsin bechayyave lavin. aval yibbume lo, shehare hi asura lo. ulefatrah belo chelum i efshar, delo allim lav lemiftera, deyalfinan lah meachot ishsha shehi becharet:
Kol hammenachot baot matztza chutz mechametz shebbattoda. dichtiv (Vayikra 7) al challot lechem chametz:
Ushete hallechem. dichtiv (sham 23) chametz teafena:

Seor haya bode lahen mittochan. mittoch issaron detoda ushete hallechem haya motzi seor, shehaya lash min hassolet meat leachar shennimdad vetomno bassolet umitchammetz meelav umimmennu mechammetz hashshear, shemmimmakom acher lo haya yachol lehavi shello tehe mincha yetera:
Hi enah min hammuvchar. sheenah machmetzet yafe, lefi sheen lah seor mechummatz yafe:
Ella mevi seor. shemmechummatz yafe mittoch beto, venoten letoch haissaron umosif umemalle solet:

Af hi hayta chasera o yetera. kegon im hasseor ave umegubbal bekoshi im meat mayim, eno machazik nefach gadol keillu haya kemach, venimtza haissaron yoter, lefi sheim lo haya seor megubbal haya nifcho gadol meachshav. veim eno megubbal yafe, shennatan bo mayim harebe, nimtza nifcho gadol mishsheillu haya kemach venimtza issaron chaser, sheim lo bishvil hammayim lo yihye male. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hattemidim enan meakkevin et hammusafim. baggemara mefaresh dilinyan kedima kaamar deen meakkevin ze et ze, dei bae temidin makriv beresha vei bae musafin makriv beresha. veaf al gav dichtiv vearach aleha haola, umashma haola dehaynu olat tamid tehe rishona lechol hakkarbanot, en ze ella lemitzva bealma aval lo leakkev:

Amar rabbi shimon ematay kulei. baggemara mefaresh dematnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, lo hikrivu keves babboker lo yakrivu ben haarbayim, bamme devarim amurim, shello nitchannech hammizbeach, aval nitchannech hammizbeach yakrivu ben haarbayim. amar rabbi shimon, ematay, bizman shehayu anusim o shoggim, aval im hayu mezidim velo hikrivu keves babboker, lo yakrivu ben haarbayim. vehachi perusho, lo hikrivu hattamid shel shachar lo yakrivu hattamid shel ben haarbayim, dehachi midrash kera, im et hakkeves echad taase babboker, huchshar sheni likkarev ben haarbayim, vei lo lo. bamme devarim amurim, shello nitchannech mizbeach, dehay kera bachinnuch ketiv befarashat veatta tetzavve, dichtiv leel minneh veze asher taase al hammizbeach. aval nitchannech mizbeach, shekkevar hikriv alav karbanot, afillu lo hikriv tamid shel shachar yakriv tamid shel ben haarbayim, dichtiv befarashat pinchas veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim keminchat habboker uchenisko, uvehahu kera lo ketiv et hakkeves haechad taase babboker, vetanya besifri hay kera lamma neemar, vahalo neemar lemala bapparasha veet hakkeves hashsheni taase kulei, lefi shenneemar immo et hakkeves echad taase babboker, hare shello hikrivu shel shachar shomea ani shello yakrivu shel ben haarbayim, talmud lomar kera batra veet hakkeves hashsheni, maggid lach sheim lo hikriv shel shachar yakriv shel ben haarbayim. aval im mezidim kulei‏ lo yakrivu ben haarbayim, otan hammezidim, aval kohanim acherim yecholim lehakeriv:

Lo hiktiru ketoret babboker yaktiru ben haarbayim. diktoret lo shechicha bechad gavra sheyyaktir ketoret peamim rabbot kemo baola, kidamrinan beyoma [26.] shello shana bah adam meolam mippene shehi meashsheret dichtiv (Devarim 33) yasimu ketora beappecha usemich leh barech Adonai‏ chelo, hilkach lo kansinan lehu, shemmittoch shehi chaviva alehem lo pashe bah veeno matzuy sheyyannichu otah mezidin. veen halacha kerabbi shimon bishtehen:

Sheen mechannechim et mizbach hazzahav ella viktoret hassammim. shel ben haarbayim. dichtiv (Shemot 30) babboker behetivo et hannerot yaktirenna, kelomar keshemmedashshen et hammenora min haefer sheyyesh sham mehadelakat hannerot. vei lav deavad hadelaka beureta may bae lemitkan betzafra, alma chinnuch hammenora ben haarbayim. vechevan dimnora nitchannecha baerev, ketoret nammi nitchannecha baerev, dichtiv (sham) uvehaalot aharon et hannerot ben haarbayim yaktirenna:
Veholid mimmenna mamzer. shehevi pesulim beyisrael vehen lo lezikkaron, lefichach en avono nimchak bitshuva:
Yachol hu sheyyachazir. deme genevato ugezelato labbealim vihe metukkan min hachet:
Lashin bah et haissa. leel ashmeinan tevul yom baadam, vehacha ashmeinan tevul yom bichli. delo tema baareva asur dilma ate leichallofe bitmea:
Notlin layyadayim lechullin ulemaaser velitruma. chullin umaaser sheni uteruma day lahem netila bichli sheen bo ella reviit mayim:

Ulekodesh matbilin. perush leechol shelamim vechattat veasham yesh maala yetera, shetztzarich lehatebil et hayyadayim bearbaim sea, veaf al pi sheenam ella setam yadayim, shello nagu betuma hametammea et kol hagguf middeorayta:

Ulechattat. ligga beme chattat, mayim hamekuddashim beefer para adumma lehazzot mehem al temee metim, yesh maala yetera, sheim nitmeu yadav beechad min haddevarim hametammeim et hayyadayim velo et hagguf, kegon sefer veochalin temeim umashkin temeim vechol tumot shemmiddivre sofrim, nitma gam hagguf, vechol hagguf tzarich tevila. vechol maalot hallalu shezze gavoah mizze, middivre sofrim hem. vehay denakat lehu hacha gabbe hilchot chagiga, lefi sheyyesh besofan hilchot haregel, sheamme haaretz chashuvim tehorim baregel, velo bishar yemot hashshana. besof chomer bakkodesh:
Haggabbaim. yisrael shehen gabbaim lemalche ummot haolam ligbot miyyisrael missim vearnoniyyot, venichnesu letoch habbayit laavot avoto:
Vechen haggannavim. shegganvu kele cheres vehechzirum:
Neemanim lomar lo naganu. letocho. vehu shehechzirum mechamat teshuva sheasu meatzmam, lo mechamat yira:

Uvirushalayim neemanim al hakkodesh. neemanim al kol kele cheres, ben gedolim ben ketannim, lomar shehen tehorin lakkodesh, lefi sheen osin kivshonot birushalayim, lefichach heeminum velo gazru alehem:
Uvishat haregel af al hatteruma. deamar kera (Shoftim 20) vayyeesof kol ish yisrael el hair keish echad chaverim, hakkatuv keraam bishat asefa kullam chaverim, veregel sheat asefa hi:
Haya menuppe bishlosh esre nafa. zo lemala mizzo. vechol ze lemitzva aval lo leakkev, sheim hevi omer issaron mearba sein o shehevio mishshene sein, lo pasal:

Rabbi shimon omer lo haya lah kitzba. daafillu lechattechilla lo natnu chachamim kitzba mikkamma sein chittin o seorin meviin omer ushete hallechem velechem happanim, ella roin bassolet shettehe menuppa kol tzarkah vedayyo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Shebbihuda neemanim vechulei. lehachi nakat bihuda, lefi shertzua shel eretz kutiyyim hayta mafseket ben galil lihuda, virushalayim eretz yehuda hayta, velo haya efshar lehavi kodesh meeretz haggalil lihuda lefi sheggazru tuma al eretz haammim, vaafillu shel chaverim shebbaggalil lo haya efshar lahavio linsachim:

Neemanin al tohorat yayin veshemen kol yemot hashshana. am haaretz sheamar yayin ze tahor vehu linsachim, shemen ze tahor vehu limnachot, neeman leolam, demishshum chumra dekodesh mizdaher velo meshakker. aval im amar yayin veshemen ellu tehorim vehen litruma, eno neeman, sheen issur tumat teruma chamur beene amme haaretz vechayshinan dilma meshakkere bah:

Uvishat haggittot vehabbaddim. beet habbatzir uveet sheotzrim hazzetim babbad, neemanin af al hatteruma, lefi shekkol bene adam metaharim et kelehem beet asiyyat hayyayin vehashshemen kede lehaferish hatteruma betohora:

Avru haggittot vechulei. leachar sheavar zeman habbatzir o zeman atzirat hazzetim bevet habbad, vehevi am haaretz chavit shel yayin o shel shemen shel teruma lechohen chaver veomer shehi tehora: lo yekabbelenna mimmennu. bechezkat tehora, dilachar haggittot vehabbaddim eno neeman:
Aval mannichah laggat habbaa. am haaretz sheyyodea shelleachar haggittot vehabbaddim eno neeman, manniach chavit zo laggat habbaa veaz notnah lakkohen, divotah shaa hu neeman aleha:
Reviit. hallog yayin linsachim, neeman al kol hechavit, demiggo dimheman akkodesh meheman nammi atteruma:

Kadde yayin vechadde shemen hamedummaot. hametaher et tivlo linsachim, vehasheta ikka chullin uteruma vekodesh meoravin umedummain ze baze, uva lomar gam al hakkaddim shehen tehorim, af al gav deam haaretz eno neeman al hakkaddim afillu bishat haggittot, haidna mehemninan leh al hakkaddim afillu kodem sheat haggittot shivim yom, demiggo dimheman akkodesh meheman nammi atteruma veakkadim, dignay hu lakkodesh sheyyihyu hakkaddim sheeruhu mehem bechezkat tuma vehu karev. veshivim yom denakat, mishshum deorcha dealma hu lehazemin et hakkelim uletaharam shivim yom kodem haggittot:
Hamechannes challot. shemmafrishin min haissa, venatan mehem harebe zo al zo ad shennidbeku zo bazo, vedato haya mittechilla lehaferidan zo mizzo:
Venashchu. shennidbeku kol kach ad shekkeshebba lehaferidan noshchot zo mizzo, kelomar shennitlash miktzat meachat mehen veole im chavertah:
Bet shammay omrim chibbur bitvul yom. veim naga tevul yom beachat mehen, nifselu kullan keillu hen guf echad. ditvul yom posel batteruma, vechalla din teruma yesh lah:
Uvet hillel omrim eno chibbur. kevan dedato lehaferidan. veotah shennaga bah hattevul yom pesula, vehashshear tehorot:

Mikratzot. chatichot shel issot shenechtechu venitleshu meissot haggedolot, keruyot mikratzot. leshon keretz mitztzafon ba va (yirmeya 46). vechol hane dachashiv hacha. appelugeta devet shammay uvet hillel desefa kayme. veha dela chashiv challot bahadayhu, mishshum dechallot levet hillel enan chibbur lo bitvul yom velo bishar tumot, aval hane davka bitvul yom pelige, aval bishar tumot modim, kidkatane sefa:
Chamita. ugga dakka:
Ad shello karmu vattannur. dechevan shennidbeku keshehen issa, hare tzuratan nifsedet im mannichan medubbakin, hilkach vadday atid lehaferidam:
Vekolit shel mayim. hakketzef veharticha sheole bammayim, kolit shemah. veim naga tevul yom beotah reticha, levet hillel lo have chibbur velo nifselu hammayim:
Mechulchelet. kesheharticha chalula mittachteha veenah nogaat bammayim ella biktzoteha:
Harishona. sherticha rishona shel gerisin enah mudbeket al haggerisin:
Rabbi yehuda omer af birticha shel orez. nammi pelige bet shammay uvet hillel i have chibbur litvul yom, vei naga barticha keillu naga baorez:
Umodim. bet hillel:
Bishar kol hattumot. dahave chibbur:
Ben kallot ben chamurot. kallot rishon lattuma. chamurot, av hattuma. vedavka bitvul yom pelige, lefi shekkevar ala mittumato veeno chaser ella haarev shemesh:
Ellu foslim et hatteruma. midderabbanan. vechullehu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo vayyom. chutz mittevul yom demiddeorayta hu:
Haochel ochel. shehu rishon lattuma o sheni lattuma, gazru sheyyehe gufo sheni lattuma, ufosel et hatteruma bemaggao, sheshsheni fosel batteruma:

Vehashshote mashkim temeim. naasa gam ken sheni lattuma ufosel et hatteruma. vetaama degazzur rabbanan behane, dezimnin deachil ochalim temeim, veshade mashkim ditruma befummeh beod shehoochalim temeim befiv, ufasel lehu. vechen nammi zimnin deshate mashkin temein, veshade ochalim ditruma befummeh beodan befiv, ufasel lehu:
Vehabba rosho verubbo. leachar shettaval bo vayyom:

Bemayim sheuvin. lefi shehayu tovlim beme mearot seruchim vehayu notnin alehem achar kach mayim sheuvin lehaavir sirchon hammayim, hitchilu vaasaum keva lomar lo me hammearot metaharim ella mayim sheuvim metaharim, amdu vegazru alehem tuma, dilma atu levattole torat mikve vetavle vishuvim, uchede lekayyem gezera zo lehaamidah, hosifu vegazru al tahor gamur shennaflu al rosho [verubbo] shelosha luggin mayim sheuvin, sheyyihye fosel et hatteruma ad sheyyitbol:

Vehassefer. kol kitve hakkodesh poslim et hatteruma bemagga. lefi shebbattechilla hayu matzniim ochalim ditruma etzel sefer tora, amre hay kodesh vehay kodesh, kevan dechazu deka atu sefarim lide feseda shehaachbarim hammetzuyin etzel hoochalim hayu mafsidim et hassefarim, gazru al tora neviim uchetuvim sheyyihyu foslim bemaggaan et hatteruma:
Utevul yom. posel et hatteruma min hattora ad sheyyaariv shimsho. veeno mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo vayyom:

Vehoochalim. shennitmeu vemashkim. chachamim gazru al hammashkim shennitmeu besheni lattuma, lihyot techilla, vitammeu et hoochalim, gezera mishshum mashkin habbain mechamat sheretz shehem techilla middeorayta. velamma lo gazru al hoochalim nammi lihyot techilla gezera mishshum ochalim habbaim mechamat sheretz, lefi shehoochalim hen tzerichin hechsher veen mekabbelin tuma ella al yede biat mayim, aval hammashkin hen alulim lekabbel tuma veen tzerichin hechsher vetikkun, vetumatan yoter metzuya:

Vechelim shennitmeu vemashkin. demiddeorayta afillu nitmeu hammashkim besheretz en metammein kelim, deen adam vechelim mekabbelin tuma ella meav hattuma, verabbanan gazru afillu al mashkin shennitmeu mechamat yadayim shehen sheniyyot, sheyyetammeu chelim, gezera mishshum mashke dezav vezava, kegon rukkan umeme raglehen shehen av hattuma umetammein kelim middeorayta:

Haomer haya va issaron mishshalosh sein. minchat haomer shemmeviin mimmochorat happesach hayu kotzrin shalosh sein dehaynu efa seorim, vetochanin oto, umenifin oto benafa shelosh esre peamim ad shemmaamidim salto al issaron shehi asirit haefa. vetaama devae issaron shel omer shalosh seim shel seorim, kevan demittevua chadasha hu veshel seorim yesh bahen subbin harebe vesolet muat velo ate esrono muvchar ella mishshalosh sein:

Shete hallechem shene esronim mishshalosh sein. kevan demechittim kaatu, af al gav demittevua chadasha atyayn, devaatzeret tevua shel chittin chadasha hi, afillu hachi shene esronim muvcharim atu mishshalosh sein:
Lechem happanim esrim vearbaa esronim. dehachi ketiv (Vayikra 24) shetem esre challot shene esronim yihye hachalla haechat:
Meesrim vearba seim. kevan demechittin atu umittevua yeshana, nafek issaron muvchar missea:

Kol hammenachot hannaasot bichli. hacha lav lemaote minchat maafe tannur ata, dichtiv (Vayikra 2) patot otah pittim vegomer‏ mincha, lerabbot kol hammenachot liftita. ella lemaote shete hallechem velechem happanim, sheen teunim petita:

Kofel achat lishnayim. dichtiv patot otah pittim. patot hayenu shenayim, dechevan denishbar hayenu shete chatichot, pittim merabbinan shettehe hachaticha lishte chatichot dehaynu arba. yachol yaasenna perurim, talmud lomar otah pittim, velo petiteha liftitim. vechullan petitin kazzetim, desefa dematnitin lav rabbi shimon kaamar leh ella divre hakkol hi, dilachar sheasa petitin kazzetim kofel kol zayit lishnayim ushenayim learbaa:
Mechappelah. lo haya mechappelah learbaa, ella lishnayim. delo ketiv bah ella minchat pittim velo patot:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Vekotza lah challa. veenah kora lah shem. dechol zeman shello kara lah shem hare hi kechullin:
Bichfisha o vinchuta. kelim sheenan mekabbelim tuma. veatzrechuha rabbanan hachi, mishshum hekkera shello tigga bah shuv meachar shekkara lah shem:
Umakkefet. mekarevet lakkeli etzlah:
Vekora lah shem. shemmitzva litrom min hammukkaf. umukkaf, leshon samuch. kemo [en] makkifin shete chaviyyot, bemassechet betza. vela chashiv mukkaf ella im ken have samuch bishat keriat hashshem:
Mippene shehi shelishi. ditvul yom din sheni yesh lo:
Hammilluim. shehayu bime moshe. keshennitchannech aharon uvanav lakkehunna:

Hayu baim kammatztza shebbattoda challot urekikim urevucha. dichtiv bammilluim (sham 8) umissal hammatzot asher lifne Adonai‏ lakach challat matztza achat vechallat lechem shemen achat verakik echad, challat matztza ellu challot, vechallat lechem shemen zo revucha demosif bah shemen keneged challot urekikim, verakik ze rakik:
Nezirut. lachme nazir, shenneemar (Bamidbar 6) vesal matztzot solet challot belulot bashshemen urekike matztzot meshuchim bashshamen. urevucha lo huzkar sham:
Shete yadot. shene chalakim shel mine matztza shebbattoda hayu bannezirut, uchedimfaresh veazel:
Nimtzeu. lannezirut:
Asara kabbin. shehare bashshelosha mine matztza shebbattoda hayu chamishsha asar kabbin, vehave lehu asara shene yadot shel chamishsha asar:

Shehen shesh esronot vaaduyan. kelomar, od shennosaf alehen. shehare hayu shelosha esronim ushelish lechol min kedaamaran leel gabbe matztza shebbattoda, nimtza lishne minim shishsha esronot ushene shelishe issaron, vehayenu dekaamar shishsha esronot vaaduyan:
Umikkullan. mikkol arbaa minim shebbattoda hayu hakkohanim notlim echad measara teruma:
Shello yittol parus. shavur vechatuch:
Sheyyihyu chol hakkarbanot shavin. hamminim yehu shavin, asara challot lechol min:
Shello yittol teruma mikkarban al chavero. sheim haya mimmin ze chamishsha umimmin ze chamishsha asar, nimtza mafrish mizze al ze:
Hattovel lechullin vehuchzak lechullin. veod zo maala. hattovel leechol chullin venitkavven litbol lihyot muchzak tahor leshem chullin:
Asur lemaaser. asur leechol maaser sheni hanneechol birushalayim, ad sheyyitbol leshem maaser. vechen kullam:
Asur bechattat. bemayim hamekuddashim beefer para:
Velo huchzak. lo nitkavven leshem tevilat tohora, ella lirchitza bealma:
Keillu lo taval. lemaaser, vechol shekken litruma ulekodesh. aval tevila hi lechullin, dechullin lo bau kavvana:
Baal keri kemagga sheretz. keshem shennogea bashsheretz rishon lattuma, kach baal keri rishon lattuma, vetumato shava letumat hannogea beshichvat zera:
Uvoel nidda kitme met. shehu av hattuma vetame tumat shiva:

Shehu metamme mishkav umoshav. umet atzmo vechol shekken teme met eno metamme mishkav umoshav, lo tuma kalla velo tuma chamura, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vechol hakkeli asher yeshev alav, hazzav, velo teme met:
Happoteach et chavito. chaver sheppatach chavito limkor yayin birushalayim baregel, umishmeshu bo amme haaretz:

Lo yigmor. leachar haregel. sheaf al pi shebbishat haregel hen tehorin, lo shettohoratan tohora olamit, ella shebbishat haregel hakkol chaverim, aval leachar haregel tame maggaan lemafrea, kidamrinan bematnitin leachar haregel matbilin kele haazara, mippene shennagu bahen amme haaretz baregel. verabbi yehuda deamar yigmor, savar im atta omer lo yigmor af hu lo yatchil, veen mazon matzuy leole regalim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Maavirin al tohorat haazara. maavirin et hakkelim mimmekoman lehatebilan uletaher et haazara mittumat amme haaretz shennagu bahen baregel:
Mippene kevod hashshabbat. shehayu hakkohanim tzerichin lehitassek betzarche shabbat ish beveto:

Af lo veyom chamishi. af im avar haregel leyom chamishi, en matbilin otan ad leachar hashshabbat. lefi sheen hakkohanim penuyin leyom motzae yom tov lehatebilan, shetterudin lehotzi et haddeshen sheal hattappuach beemtza hammizbeach, shekkavtzu sham kol yemot haregel kol deshen shel hammaaracha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Min hammodiit velifnim. modiit kerach rachok mirushalayim chamesh esre mil. mimmennu velifnim, letzad yerushalayim, neemanim kaddarim amme haaretz likkach mehen kele cheres haddakkim, kegon kosot kederot vekitonot. lefi shei efshar belo hem. uvirushalayim en osin kivshonot, mippene heashan, lo lesid velo likderot, lefichach heeminum velo gazru alehem, sheen gozrim gezera al hatztzibbur sheen yecholin laamod bah:
Hu hakkaddar. mi shehevian michutz lammodiit lo bilvad heeminu, lefi shei efshar shello lehaamino, aval im mesaram leyad kaddar acher am haaretz hayyoshev bammodiit o lifnim, lo heeminuhu:
Vehen hakkederot. al otan kederot shehevi hu neeman, veeno neeman letzaref immahem kederot shel kaddar acher sheyyoshev bemodiit o lifnim:
Vehen hallokchin. chaverim sherauhu sheheviam, neeman hakkaddar etzlam, velo etzel lokchim acherim:
Yatza. min hammodiit lashuv laachorav, eno neeman:
Kuppach. mekom shefitat kedera achat. ufeamim shemmassikim oto veofin bo issa:
Reafim. 351 belaaz. asuyin mecheres umassikin otan bakkivshan:
Veyorot haarvin. kemin gumma haasuya bakkarka vetucha betit, umassikin esh betochah ad shettitlabben, veofim bah issa:
Im ratza yavi maase chuppach. dechuppach min tannur hu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Minchat maafe. ketive bah challot urekikim:
Lo yavi mechetza challot. dechol menachot baot eser eser, veze lo yavi chamesh challot vechamesh rekikin, ella o hakkol challot o hakkol rekikin:
Mippene shehu karban echad. sheshshenehem ketuvim bemincha achat, hilkach yachol lehavi mechetza mimmin ze umechetza mimmin ze. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hetter nedarim porchim baavir. meat remez yesh bammikra sheyyuchal hechacham lehattir hanneder, veen lismoch alav, ella kach masur lachachamim battora shebbeal pe:
Hilchot shabbat vehilchot chagiga vehilchot meila. yesh bahen halachot shehen teluyot beremez, bemikra muat, kehar hattaluy besaarot harosh:
Vehaavodot. hilchot avodat hakkarbanot:

Hen hen gufe tora. baggemara mefaresh dehen vehen gufe tora kaamar. kelomar ben otan sheen lahem al ma sheyyismochu uven otan sheyyesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu, ben otan shehen kahararim hatteluyin besaara, ellu veellu gufe tora:
Enah nifselet bitvul yom. devatar issa azlinan velo batar seor, af al gav daasura lezarim:
Shehuchshera vemashke. shellatat hachittin bemayim:
Venillosha veme ferot. ume perot en machshirin, vehaissa shennillosha bahen im lo huchshera techilla, enah mekabbelet tuma:
Pasal et kullah. deme perot osin haissa chibbur:
Lo pasal ella mekom maggao. kasavar rabbi akiva dechevan deme perot en machshirin velo mayte lehu lide tuma, roin otan keillu enan, velo pasal ella mekom maggao. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Lagin. keen kad shel etz:
Umilahu min hechavit. sheyyesh bah maaser tevel, hayenu maaser rishon shello nittela terumato:
Terumat maaser mishshettechshach. kede sheyyaariv shimsho shel lagin velo yifsol et hatteruma. deim hayta teruma chala mibbeod yom, hayta nifselet bitvul yom:
Hare ze eruv. lo amar kelum. lefi sheen kone eruv ella visudda haruya mibbeod yom, veze eno rauy ad haarev shemesh:
Nishbera hechavit. mibbeod yom:
Hallagin betivlo. shebbeshaa shehaya rauy sheyyikkava teruma lo haya baolam haddavar shennaasa teruma alav, hilkach lo chal alav shem teruma vahare hu tevel:
Nishbar hallagin. mibbeod yom:
Hechavit betivlah. shello chal shem teruma al hallagin ella mishshettechshach, uveotah shaa lo haya baolam:
Mippiha umishshuleha temea. mippiha temea, hoil vechol hayyayin shellematta naasa basis laelyon, have chibbur. umishshuleha nammi, hoil vechol hayyayin nimshach achar hannekev, have chibbur:
Aval nikkeva mitztziddah mikkan umikkan tehora. veen pasul ella ma shennaga, veyaale beechad umea. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Venaga tevul yom bakkilluach. hakkilluach levad nifsal, denitztzok eno chibbur, vehaveya la teruma temea shennitarva bithora, vetaale beechad umea, kitruma bechullin. uveha afillu rabbanan modu, dekilluach la chashiv chibbur lakkelim kemo hannekev shebbetziddah lechavit. veaf al gav demashkin en lahem tohora mittumatan, hayenu delo salka lehu hashshaka bemikve kemo lemayim, aval mittaam bittul, betelim hem beechad umea. vedavka bemagga tevul yom betelim hammashkin, mishshum ditvul yom posel veeno metamme. aval bishar tumot, ka hadar ma shebbakkilluach umetamme kol ma shebbakkeli bemagga:
Meviim shelamim. shalme chagiga, lefi sheyyesh bahem tzorech achila lehedyot:
Veen somchin alehem. ella somech alehen mibbeod yom. delo bainan vesamach veshachat techef lismicha shechita:
Aval lo olot. olat yachid, vaafillu olat reiyya, shehare yachol lehakerivah bishar yemot haregel, deamar kera (Bamidbar 29) atzeret tihye lachem, lachem velo legavoah:
Uvet hillel omrim meviin shalme chagiga veolot reiyya. dichtiv (Devarim 16) atzeret laAdonai, kol dela. aval nedarim unedavot, ben olot ben shelamim, divre hakkol en kerevin beyom tov:
Ketzad eshet achiv vechulei. poteret tzaratah:
Venolad lahen ach. umetzaah zekuka leyavam, vealav asura mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo:
Veachar kach yibbem hashsheni et eshet achiv. velo ishsha acheret:
Vamet. belo vanim:
Harishona. hi eshet harishon, shennafla lefanav kevar paam achat, yotzet mishshum eshet achiv shello haya beolamo:
Asa vah. ze shemmet:

Maamar. perush shekkiddeshah bechesef. uvivama kiddushin shel kesef enam kiddushin gemurim ella middivre sofrim, sheen hayyevama niknet layyavam lihyot keeshet ish gemura ad sheyyavo aleha, veze lo hispik lechansah ad shemmet:
Sheniyya choletzet. velo maftera mishshum tzarat erva, delav tzaratah mammash hi:
Velo mityabbemet. mishshum demaamar kone miktzat vehaveya lah tzarat erva bemiktzat. vechol makom sheen sham kiddushin gemurim choletzet velo mityabbemet:

Tzeror shebbakkikkar. shergilim lasum tzeror even betoch hakkikkar lesiman shello yitchallef beacher, ufeamim shemmesimin garger shel melach gadol o turmos. kol hane la chashive chibbur belechem, veim naga av hattuma beechad mehen, lo have keillu naga ballechem atzmo. vechol shekken tevul yom shello nifsal kikkar shel teruma bechach:
Vehacharchur yater mikkeetzba. vechen keshennisraf min hallechem beyoter meovi etzba, venaga tame o tevul yom bassaruf, lo have chibbur lallechem:
Rabbi yose omer kol sheeno neechol immo. lo have chibbur. velo meshaarinan boovi etzba ketanna kamma. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Mechallelin al perot am haaretz. mechallelim maaser sheni al perot am haaretz, veen choshshin shemma happerot shel am haaretz maaser hen venimtza mechallel maaser bemaaser:
Chazru lomar af al hammaot. shel am haaretz, mechallelin perot maaser sheni, veen choshshin shemma maot hallalu shel am haaretz maot shel maaser sheni hen:
Hayyotze vakkolar. beshalshelet. targum vayyittenuhu vassugar (Yechezkel 19), veyahavuhu vekolarin:
Hare ellu yichtevu veyittenu. veaf al gav shello amar tenu, vadday bae lememar kitvu utenu, veaggav beatoteh lo paskeh lemilleteh:
Mefaresh. min hayyabbasha layyam:
Bishyara. bammidbar. orchat yishmeelim (Bereshit 37), metargeminan sheyarat aravae:
Af hamesukkan. chole hannote lamut. vahalacha kerabbi shimon shezuri:
Teunot haggasha. bechuddah shel keren deromit maaravit, kedichtiv (sham 2) vehiggishah el hammizbeach:
Vehachallot veharkikin. minchat maafe tannur:
Minchat kohanim. shehi kullah kalil:
Vechol sheen bahem kemitza. lehattir hashshirayim min hammincha lakkohanim, en bahen haggasha. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hashshochet et hattoda bifnim. lifnim min haazara:

Velachmah chutz lachoma. baggemara mokminan la chutz lechomat bet pagi. rabbotay pershu chutz lachoma hachitzona shel yerushalayim. [aval chutz laazara kadosh]. veaf al gav dichtiv (Vayikra 7) vehikriv al zevach hattoda challot, demashma lichora sheyyehe hallechem etzlah bishat zevicha, lo darshinan al besamuch. verambam gores bet baggi. umefaresh shehu makom karov lehar habbayit ella shehu chutz lechomat har habbayit vesham ofim hammenachot. veal shem kach hayu korim lo bet baggi. leshon pat bag hammelech:
Ad shello karmu vattannur. lav lechem ninhu. ella issa bealma:

Shechatah. al menat leachla chutz lizmannah, kadash hallechem venifgal. al menat leachlah chutz limkomah, kadash hallechem venifsal. vetaama dekadash hallechem, mishshum difsulo bakkodesh, vekayma lan kol sheppesulo bakkodesh hakkodesh mekabbelo:
Shechatah venimtzet terefa lo kadash hallachem. difsulo kodem shechita hu:

Shechatah venimtzet baalat mum rabbi eliezer omer kadash. baggemara moke la bedukkin shebbaayin, divchi hay muma savar rabbi eliezer deim alu lo yerdu hoil veen muman nikkar, hilkach kadash hallechem. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Shello lishmah. lo kadash hallechem, dichtiv (Vayikra 7) al challot lechem chametz yakriv karbano al zevach todat shelamav, al zevach shennizbach leshem todat shelamav:
Vechen el hammilluim. lefi shehen hayu techilla lechol hakkarbanot nakat el hammilluim. vehu haddin leel nazir, demilluim kekarban yachid hen chashuvim:
Hamechannes challot. zo al gabbe zo:
Al menat shello lehaferish. shello lehaferidan zo mizzo:
Mishshekkarmu vattannur. dimachar sheen tzuratan nifsedet venisharin rekikin kemo shehayu, hu mannichan medubbakin veshuv en mafridan zo mizzo leolam:
Veshel shemen leolam. ben chadash ben yashan:
Tofach. min kitnit. verambam omer, shehu shekkorin lo baaravi 406. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Temeim bitvul yom. mishshum sefa detane veen tzarich lomar bechol hattumot, nakat temeim etzel tevul yom, veaf al gav delo shayyach tuma gabbe tevul yom, lefi sheeno metamme ella posel batteruma bilvad:
Bet shammay mattirin. tzarat erva lehityabbem leachiv. delet lehu hach derasha delitzror:
Chaltzu. hatztzarot min haachin:
Bet shammay poslin. hatztzarot min hakkehunna, shechalitzatan chalitza:
Uvet hillel machshirin. shechalitzatan shello letzorech hayta, vahare hi kecholetzet min nachri:
Nityabbemu. laachin:
Bet shammay machshirin. otan lakkohanim im nitalmenu miyvamehem:
Uvet hillel poslim. shennivalu laasur lahem, vehannivelet laasur lah asaah zona, vezona asura lechohen:

Lo nimneu. veaf al pi shebbene hatztzarot shennityabbemu kedivre bet shammay mamzerim hem levet hallel, shehare beissur eshet ach hem alehem veeshet ach becharet, uvene chayyave keritut mamzerim hem, af al pi chen lo nimneu bet hillel millissa nashim mibbet shammay, lefi shehayu modiim lahem otan habbaot min hatztzarot uforshin mehen:

Ellu al gabbe ellu. mashilim kelehem ellu leellu. uvaggemara parech aha ditnan bet shammay mattirin et hatztzarot laachim uvet hillel osrim, kare kan lo titgoddu, lo taasu agudot agudot. umeshane, kegon bet din echad beir achat, pelag morim kevet shammay ufelag morim kevet hillel. aval shene batte dinim beir achat, vechol shekken shene batte dinim bishte ayarot, let lan bah:
Shifa. shemmeshafshef hachitta ben yado lakkeli kede shettehe nocha lehashir kelippatah:
Beita. shebboet boovi egrofo o boovi pas yado. vehaya shaf achat uvoet shetayim, shaf shetayim uvoet shalosh, vechozer veose kasseder hazze ad sheggomer chamesh meot beitot lishlosh meot shifot:
Hachi garsinan rabbi yose omer babbatzek. kelomar, shifa uveita babbatzek velo bachittin. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Eser eser challot. uminchat solet nammi af al gav dekodem afiyya nikmetzet, afillu hachi eser challot hi baa:
Lechem happanim. behedya ketiv beh shetem esre challot:

Vachavitte chohen gadol. neemar belechem happanim chak olam veneemar bachavitte kohen gadol chak olam, ma lehallan shetem esre challot, af kan shetem esre challot, umakrivin mehen shesh challot babboker veshesh challot baerev:
Chutz mechallot toda shehen baot eser. kidvainan lememar taama lekamman beidach pirkin. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Vechayyav al hashshemen. im netano al minchat chote o al minchat kenaot:
Natan keli. sheyyesh bo shemen:
Al gabbe keli. shel minchat chote:
Lo fesalah. velo amrinan hare avar al ma shekkatuv battora lo yasim aleha shemen, shello hizhira tora ella shello yitten hashshemen letoch hassolet o letoch hakkemach:
Yose ben yoezer omer shello lismoch. beyom tov. mippene shemmishtammesh bevaale chayyim, shebbechol kocho hu somech. vezo hammachaloket hayta ben hannesiim uven avot bet din, dor achar dor:

Yatza menachem. laavodat hammelech, ufarash millihyot chavero shel hillel. lefichach lo hoda meinyano im nechlak im hillel beze im lav, venichnas shammay bimkomo lihyot av bet din tachtav, venechlak al hillel:
Harishonim. shehuzkeru rishon bechol zug hayu nesiim:

Bibua shebbechavit. keshemmetzarfin kele cheres bechivshan yotzin bedafnotehen kemin avabuot, sheyyesh lahen shete defanot, achat letzad penim shel chavit veachat letzad chutz, vechalul baemtza, ufeamim sheyyesh beoto bibua shete nekavim, echad bedofen habbibua shel tzad penim shehu letzad chalal hechavit, veechad baddofen shel tzad chutz, ucheshehechavit melea mashkim, nichnas hammashke derech hannekev shebbaddofen happenimi umevatzbetz veyotze derech hannekev shebbaddofen hachitzon. veim hannekavim shebbishte dafnot habbibua hen mechuvvanim umefullashim ze keneged ze, o afillu enan mechuvvanim ella shehaya hannekev shebbaddofen happenimi lematta letzad shule hakkeli vehannekev shebbaddofen hachitzon millemala, im hayta otah chavit munnachat beohel hammet umukkefet tzamid patil befiha veenah mukkefet bannekavim shel habbibua, o shennaga av hattuma bammashke shebbannekev hachitzon, nitmeu kol hammashkim shebbechavit. aval im happenimi millemalan vehachitzon millemattan, nehi divohel hammet mittamme, sheohel hattuma nichnas letoch hechavit derech hannekavim, beav hattuma miha tahor, deim naga av hattuma bammashkin shebbannekev hachitzon shebbabbibua millemattan, meachar shehappenimi millemalan, have leh kenitztzok uketafres, velo have chibbur:

Happarim vehaelim vehakkevasim. hanach dichtive befarashat emor el hakkohanim vehikravtem al hallechem shivat kevasim temimim bene shana ufar ben bakar echad veelim shenayim, habbaim im shete hallechem shel atzeret, enam meakkevim. happarim shenayim veayil echad veshiva kevasim shel musafim shel atzeret hakketuvim befarashat pinchas. sheen [shene] parim shel musafim meakkevin happar shel shete hallechem, velo happar shel shete hallechem meakkev shene parim shel musafim. vechen shene elim shel shete hallechem enan meakkevin haayil echad shel musafim, velo ayil echad shel musafim meakkev shene haelim shel shete hallechem. vechen hakkevasim en meakkevin ellu et ellu:

Rabbi shimon omer im hayu lahem parim merubbin. kelomar, damim kede liknot parim kede tzarkan, velo hayu lahem damim liknot nesachim, yaviu far echad unesachav. umappik lah mikkera dichtiv (Yechezkel 46) efa lappar veefa laayil yaase mincha velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado, vechi middat parim veelim achat hi, vahalo minchat parim shelosha issaron uminchat elim shene issaron, ella lehodiacha shemmutav lehavi par echad ayil echad im efato, midda haruya lo, millehavi parim merubbim veelim merubbim belo minchatam. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kelim hannigmarim betohora. sheggemaran chaver, venizhar bahem mishshebbau karov legamran shehem reuyin lekabbel tuma, af al pi chen tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, chayshinan shemma nittaz rok mippi am haaretz al hakkeli beshaa shehaya hechaver ochez bo. veaf al pi shebbeotah shaa adayin lo nigmar hakkeli velo haya mekabbel tuma, shemma leachar shennigmar vehaya rauy lekabbel tuma adayin haya harok lach umetamme, ditnan bemassechet nidda hazzov veharok metammein lachim:

Hakkeli metzaref ma shebbetocho. hayu chatichot harebe shel ochalin bichli echad venaga tevul yom shehu posel et hatteruma beachat mehen, hakkeli metzarfan lihyot kullan chashuvim kachaticha achat venifselu kullan, dichtiv (Bamidbar 7) kaf achat asara zahav, hakkatuv asao lechol ma shebbakkaf achat:
Aval lo latteruma. ella otah chaticha shennaga bah hi pesula, vehashshear tehorot:
Harvii bakkodesh pasul. veeno posel:
Im nitmet achat miyyadav. betumot derabbanan, kegon beochalin umashkin temeim vechayyotze bahen, sheen metammein ella yadayim velo et hagguf:
Uvakkodesh matbil et shetehen. vehu shettishshaer lachluchit bayyad hattemea bashshaa shennitmea. aval lo haya lachluchit bayyad hattemea, en hayyad haacheret temea ad shettigga bah:

Lo choletzet velo mityabbemet. tzaratah, vechol shekken hi. vechen aylonit, dichtiv (Devarim 25) asher teled, perat leaylonit. vechen eshet seris chamma veanderoginos, lo choletzet velo mityabbemet, shenneemar (sham) uven en lo, perat leellu sheen rauy lihyot lahem banim. veeshet ger veeshet eved meshuchrar, lo choltzot velo mityabbemot, sheen achava laggerim velo laavadim. aval akara uzekena, o choltzot o mityabbemot:

Achotah. shel erva: keshehi yevimtah. kegon shennaflu lo shete achayot mishshene echav, vehaachat asura alav mishshum erva, kegon shehi chamoto o kallato: choletzet o mityabbemet. dehashta lo paga baachot zekukato, mishshum deerva lav zekukato hi:
Mashke tevul yom. kegon rukko, meme raglav, dimot eno, vedam maggafto, vachalev haishsha:
Kemashkim shehu nogea bahen. kemashkim shel teruma shehu nogea bahen. ditvul yom posel batteruma:
Ellu vaellu. mashkim hayyotzim miggufo umashke teruma shennaga bahen, en metammein et hakkodesh, aval mifsal pasel leh:
Ben kallin ben chamurin. kallin sheretz, chamurin zav:
Techilla. rishon, veosin sheni, vehashsheni ose shelishi:
Chutz min hammashke shehu av hattuma. kegon zovo shel zav umayenotav:
Vamet. hameyabbem:

Meyabbem leezo sheyyirtze. ufoteret chavertah. velav aasa bah maamar kae, ella aresha kae dekatane harishona asura vechulei, vekaamar rabbi shimon kevan shekkeshennolad kevar nityabbema, velo hayta al ze bezikat nissue achiv harishon meolam, mutteret lo. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Hasseora vehakkussemet. bizman sheenan kelufim la chashive maachal adam, sheen bene adam ochlin otan biklippatan, vedavar sheeno maachal adam eno mekabbel tuma:
Hattia. shoresh shel chiltit:
Vehachiltit. baaravit kach shemah chiltit. vekorin lehu belaaz 174:
Vehaalum. amru alav shehu shoresh min mimmine hachiltit. vechol hane la chashive maachal adam, ufeamim mearvin mehem meat im hammazon:
Af afunim shechorin. sheenan ella lirfua veen asuyot lemaachal adam:

Tehorim bitvul yom. kevan shettahar mittumato veeno mechussar ella haarev shemesh, eno posel bechol elle im hem shel teruma. aval bishar tumot chashive ochel umekabbelot tuma kishar ochalin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hakketzach. min zera shachor. uvelaaz 106. uregilin latet mimmennu ballechem:
Vehashshumshom. kach shemo baaravi. uveeretz yisrael mimmennu harebe, veosim mimmennu shemen shumshemin:
Hammikpa. tavshil kafuy veav. kegon daysa o gerisin shel pol:
Vehashshum vehashshemen. netunim bo letavlin:
Naga tevul yom bemiktzatan pasal et kullam. demikpa ikkar, utevul yom posel batteruma. veaf al pi shello naga ella bashshum shel chullin, chashuv chibbur:
Veim haya hashshum merubbe. yoter min hammikpa shel chullin:
Holchin achar hamerubbe. vedin hakkol kedin teruma. veim naga bemiktzatam, pasal et hakkol:
Ematay. kelomar bamme amarnu im haya hashshum merubbe venaga bammiktzat hu posel et hakkol, bizman shehashshum mechunnas bakkeara, vehu guf echad kemin gush afar:

Aval im haya mefuzzar bammedocha. shechalakav meforadim ze mizze betoch hammedocha, venaga bo tevul yom, az tahor, kelomar lo pasal ella mekom maggao bilvad, shekkevan shehu mitkavven beshaa shekkotesh lehaferid chalakav, lo chashuv chibbur:
Ushear kol hanniddochin sheddachan bemashkin. kemo sheosin lachittin, kesheddachin otan bimdocha mezallefim alehem mayim:

O devarim sheddarkan laduch bemashkin. vedachan shello vemashkin vehen gush bakkeara, hare hen keiggule devela. deim naga tevul yom bemiktzatan, lo pasal et kullan. kach matzati beferush rabbotay. verambam mefaresh, ushear kol hanniddochin sheddachan bemashkin [kelomar, vechen shear kol hanniddochim sheddachan bemashkin], dinam kashshum, sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzato keshekkotesh oto [bammedocha], lo pasal ella mekom maggao, mippene shehu rotze befizzuro. veim naga bo keshennaasa gush bakkeara, have chibbur, ucheshennaga bemiktzat pasal et hakkol:
Aval et sheddarkan laduch bemashkin. garsinan lefi perush rambam:
Vedachan shello vemashkin. af al pi shessam oto gush bakkeara, hare hen keiggule devela, deamrinan dechi naga bemiktzato lo nitmeu kullan, beresh perek 2‏ ditrumot:
Log vaasham metzora. ketiv behu vehenif:
Vehabbikkurim kedivre rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. garsinan. kelomar, deshaminan leh bealma deamar bikkurim teunim tenufa, vahalacha kemoto:
Veemure shalme yachid vechaze vashok shellahen. behedya ketiv behu (Vayikra 10) shok hatteruma vachaze hattenufa al ishshe hachalavim yaviu lehanif:
Echad shalme anashim veechad shalme nashim. teunim tenufa:

Beyisrael aval lo vaacherim. mefaresh baggemara dehachi kaamar, echad anashim veechad nashim karbanan taun tenufa, utenufa atzmah beyisrael, aval lo bide nashim, dehachi tanya, bene yisrael menifin veen haggoyim menifin, bene yisrael menifin velo benot yisrael menifot:

Shete hallechem vechivse shelamim shel atzaret. habbaim biglal hallechem. ketiv behu (sham 23) vehenif hakkohen otam al lechem habbikkurim, velo al mammash, ella samuch lahem, kevasim betzad hallechem, kedivre rabbi babberayta. vechen halacha:
Shenneemar. [bammilluim] (Shemot 29) asher hunaf vaasher huram, umehunaf vehuram demilluim yalfinan shear tenufot. tenufa, molich umevi. teruma, maale umorid:
Tenufa hayta vammizrach. kelomar, af bammizrach shel mizbeach yachol lehanif, vechol shekken bemaaravo dekarov yoter lahechol:

Utenufot kodmot lahaggashot. bitchilla menif veachar kach maggish. uveminchat haomer uveminchat kenaot ayre ditunot tenufa vehaggasha, uchetiv beminchat kenaot (Bamidbar 5) vehenif et hammincha lifne Adonai, vahadar vehikriv otah el hammizbeach:

Nesachim shekkadshu vichli. lav davka bichli. sheen nesachim mitkaddeshim lippasel beyotze uvelina veaf al pi shekkadshu bichli, ella bishchitat hazzevach, dichtiv zevach unesachim, hannesachim teluyim bazzevach:
Venimtza hazzevach pasul. shennifsal bazzerika. deillu bashshechita nifsal, lo kadshu nesachim:

Im yesh sham zevach acher yikrevu immo. binsachim shel tzibbur mokminan la lematnitin, mishshum delev bet din matne alehem, im hutzrechu lezevach ze hutzrechu veim lav yihyu lezevach acher. aval binsachim shel yachid en kesherim lezevach acher. vaafillu nesachim shel tzibbur en kerevim im zevach acher ella im ken haya oto zevach zavuach keshennifsal hazzevach harishon, aval im lo haya zavuach beshaa shennifsal hazzevach harishon, en kerevim im hazzevach haacher. umatnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, yikrevu immo, bamme devarim amurim shehaya zevach zavuach beotah shaa, aval im lo haya zevach zavuach beotah shaa naase kemo shennifselu belina ufesulim. vehachi mipparsha matnitin baggemara. vechol zeman shello nitkaddeshu nesachim bichli af al pi shennishchat hazzevach yecholim lehakeriv nesachim afillu achar kamma yamim, dekayma lan mevi adam karbano hayyom venisko afillu achar kamma yamim, ben nesachim shel yachid ben nesachim shel tzibbur. vechen metzora mevi ashamo hayyom velog shemen shello leachar kamma yamim:
Velad toda. shehifrish toda meubberet veyalda:

Vechen hammafrish todato veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha enah teuna lechem. harishona, im nimtzet leachar hakeravat sheniyya. vechen sheniyya im nimtzet harishona kodem hakeravatah vehikriv rishona, shuv en hashsheniyya teuna lechem:
Chalifatah. hayenu hammafrish toda veavda vehifrish acheret tachteha:
Temuratah. kegon sheomedet been veomer zo temurat zo, uchetiv (Vayikra 27) vehaya hu utemurato yihye kodesh:
Happar vehaelim vehakkevasim vehassair. habbaim biglal hallechem. vechullan olot, chutz min hassair shehu chattat:
En meakkevin et hallechem. sheim heviu shete hallechem shel atzeret belo hakkarbanot hallalu, mekuddashin:
Hallechem meakkev et hakkevasim. hanach kevasim hen shene kevasim dishlamim shehuzkeku litnufa im hallechem:
Vehakkevasim en meakkevim et hallechem. sheim lo nimtzeu kevasim meviim shete hallechem vehen kedoshim keillu hevium im hakkevasim:
Karvu chevasim belo lechem. shehare lo haya lahem lechem bammidbar ella hamman:
Halacha kedivre ven nannas. dichvasim meakkevim et hallechem:
Aval en hattaam kidvarav. dehu omer bammidbar karvu kevasim dishlamim, velo hi:
Shekkol haamur bechummash happekudim. besefer bemidbar, kegon karbenot musafim haamurim befarashat pinchas, karvu bammidbar:
