Vechol haamur betorat kohanim. dehaynu besefer vayyikra, lo karvu bammidbar. vehanach kevasim haamurim beemor el hakkohanim kegon hanach shiva kevasim ufar veelim deola deal hallechem ushene kevasim dishlamim lo karvu bammidbar:
Lechem belo chevasim en lo mi yattirennu. sheen hallechem muttar baachila lakkohanim ad sheyyikrevu kevasim. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. velo min hammaaser. dechevan deamar hare alay have leh davar shebbechova, vechol davar shebbechova eno ba ella min hachullin:

Veim amar hare alay toda min hachullin velachmah min hammaaser yavi hi velachmah min hachullin. delechem nigrar achar toda, vechevan deamar hare alay toda min hachullin beal karcheh ichayyav leh ballechem, hilkach hay demahadar veamar lachmah min hammaaser lav kelum hu:
Toda min hammaaser velachmah min hachullin yavi. kelomar yavi kemo shennadar. velav chova, dechol shekken im yavi shenehem min hachullin deshappir avad. ella im ratza lehavi kemo shennadar yavi:
Velo yavi. hallechem: mechitte maaser sheni. atzmo, delechem dumeya dishlamim bainan, ma shelamim mimmeot maaser sheni velo mimmaaser sheni atzmo, af lechem ken:

Minchat solet. hammitnaddev mincha setam, mevi solet veshemen ulevona, uvollah vekomtzah kemo shehi kodem afiyya. uvedidah ketiv shemen ulevona, vechol hane acharine gamre mimminchat solet dichtiv bah nefesh, demashma dechol minchat yachid teuna shemen ulevona:
Vehachallot veharkikin. leminchat maafe tannur kare hachallot veharkikin. dei bae challot mayte vei bae rekikin mayte:
Uminchat kohanim. kohen shehitnaddev achat mechameshet menachot hallalu:
Minchat kohen mashiach. minchat chavittin:
Goy. mitnaddev mincha, kidyalfinan meish ish, melammed shehannachrim meviin nedarim unedavot keyisrael:
Uminchat nashim. ishsha shehitnaddeva mincha:
Uminchat nesachim. lo bae levona, deshemen neemar bah velo levona:
Velechem happanim. ketiv beh (Vayikra 24) venatatta al hammaarechet levona zakka, velo ketiv beh shemen:
Shete hachallot. shel atzeret, lo huzkar bahen lo shemen velo levona:
Minchat chote uminchat kenaot. behedya ketiv behu (sham 5) lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona:
Hammikpa vehachamita. darkan haya lehanniach hachamita, shehi ugga dakka kemin rakik, betoch hammikpa:

Chibbetz. hayenu sheerev hammikpa vehachamita im hashshemen, umikkol makom hashshemen nikkar. veha defasel bechol makom shehillech hashshemen, lefi sheen yecholin lehaferido min hammikpa umin hachamita:
Besar hakkodesh shekkaram alav hakkippa. kafu alav hattavlin vehammarak veshumman habbasar, shennimmoach venaasa hakkol kemin kerum:
Hachatichot muttarot. delo have hakkerum chibbur:
Vechol haolim immah. chashiv mechubbar lah. vehashshear tahor:
Shenehem chibbur. uven shennaga bakkippa ben shennaga bachatichot, pasal hakkol. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Al gabbe ferusot. shel lechem shemmannichin al hakkitniyyot:
Maase kedera vakkitniyyot. kelomar, kitniyyot shennitbashshelu bikdera vedarkan lehitbakkea, ucheshemmitbashshelot yafe mitchabberot venaasot kemin gush. veyesh sheggorsin, maase kedera vekitniyyot:
Hare ellu yimmanu. im naga sheretz beechad mehen, hare hu rishon. vehaggush hassamuch lo sheni, vehaacher hassamuch lashsheni shelishi batteruma:
Shenehen chibbur ze laze. veim naga tevul yom beechad mehen, nifsal chavero. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Keshem shebbitto petura. shehare asura lo, veen sham ach ella hu, kach tzaratah petura:

Halcha tzarat bitto venisset leachiv hashsheni. hecha deyesh ach acher sheshshetehen muttarot lo, veenan peturot, shehare yesh kan mitzvat yibbum, umityabbemet haachat vehashsheniyya petura, dichtiv (Devarim 25) et bet achiv, bayit echad hu bone veen bone shete battim. veim yibbem achiv hashsheni et tzarat bitto velo ishsha acheret umet belo vanim vechazru venaflu lefanav:
Keshem shetztzarat bitto petura. shenneesra alav mishsheat nefilat achiv harishon, kach tzarat tzaratah, eshet achiv hashsheni haacheret, petura, shezzo potartah, shetztzarat erva poteret tzaratah:
Vaafillu hem mea. achim, vehalcha tzarat tzaratah shel bitto venityabbema leachiv hashshelishi, velo ishsha acheret umet belo banim, shetehen asurot al ze. vechen leolam:
Tzaratah mutteret. lehityabbem. shehare bishat zikkat yibbum enah tzaratah:

Vechol hayyechola lemaen. shehi ketanna haerva, vichola lemaen velo meana, umet achiv, hoil vekiddusheha enan ella midderabbanan vezikka shellah enah ella midderabbanan, enah poteret tzaratah min hachalitza. ulehityabbem asura, shenniret ketzarat erva:
Ach mikkol makom. vaafillu mamzer:
Achiv lechol davar. leyorsho velhittame lo:

Shifcha venachrit. veladah batrah azil, dichtiv beshifcha (Shemot 21) haishsha viladeha tihye ladoneha. uvenachrit ketiv (Devarim 7) ki yasir et bincha meacharay, umiddelo chetiv ki tasir, shema minna hachi kaamar, bittecha lo titten livno, ki yasir baal bittecha et bincha shetteled lo bittecha meacharay, aval abbitto lo tikkach levincha lo mehaddar, sheen habben habba min hannachrit karuy bincha ella benah:

Ochlin ochalim neguvim beyadayim mesoavot batteruma. hachi kaamar, ochlin ochalim shel chullin neguvin beyadayim mesoavot im hatteruma, aval lo im hakkodesh. mi shettachav lo chavero ochalin shel kodesh befiv beyadayim tehorot, veze haochel yadav mesoavot, o shettachav hu atzmo ochalin shel kodesh befiv al yede kush o karkar, uvikkesh leechol tzenon o batzal shel chullin immahen, sheen yadayim mesoavot hashsheniyyot lattuma metammeot et hachullin, afillu hachi gazur rabbanan shello yochlem im hakkodesh, shemma yigga beyadav mesoavot boochalin shel kodesh shebbefiv. uleinyan teruma, af al pi shehayyadayim hamesoavot poslot, lo asu maala zo, ella amrinan zahir velo naga. ulehachi nakat neguvim, sheillu haya achshav mashkin alehem, hayu hammashkin naasim rishonim mechamat hayyadayim veosin et hachullin sheniyyim, ucheshennogin batteruma shebbefiv poslim otah:
Haonen. shello nitma bemeto:
Umechussar kippurim. shettaval veheeriv shimsho velo hevi karbenotav:

Tzerichin tevila. leachar sheyyavi karbano, im ratza leechol kodesh, kevan dead haidna hayu asurim bakkodesh atzrechinhu rabbanan tevila. umechussar kippurim posel et hakkodesh bingia. vehaonen af al pi sheasur leechol eno posel bingia:

Aval lo latteruma. dimchussar kippurim veonen muttarim batteruma. veaf al gav deonen asur bemaaser sheni, muttar hu batteruma, dimrabbinan leh mivchol zar lo yochal kodesh (Vayikra 22), zarut amarti lecha velo aninut:
Shelosha minin. shalme yachid, veshalme tzibbur shehem kivse atzeret, vaasham metzora. shelosha minim hallalu teunim ben shelashtan shalosh mitzvot, semicha, tenufa chayyim, tenufa shechutim:
Shetayim. mitzvot min hashshalosh yesh bechol min vamin, vehashshelishit en bahem. deen bechol min ella shetayim:
Shalme yachid. ketiv behu semicha bevayyikra:
Utenufa shechutim. bechaze vashok shellahen, betzav et aharon:

Shalme tzibbur. ketiv behu tenufa chayyim, vehenif hakkohen otam dehaynu chayyim, utenufa shechutim, bechaze vashok shellahen, deyalfinan (mikdashi) [mishshalme] yachid. aval semicha lo bau, dehilchata gemire la deen bechol karbenot tzibbur ella shete semichot bilvad, semicha shel sair hammishtalleach veshel par helem davar shel tzibbur:
Asham metzora. ketiv beh tenufa chay, kedichtiv vehenif hakkohen otam, befarashat zot tihye. usemicha, dei efshar lekarban yachid shello yismoch yado al rosh karbano:
Aval lo tenufa shachut. demiet rachamana gabbe shalme yachid, (Vayikra 7) et hechaze lehanif oto. oto, lemaote asham shel metzora sheeno taun tenufa shachut:

Ellu menachot nikmatzot. minchat solet nikmetzet issa, uminchat machavat umarcheshet vechallot urekikim dehaynu maafe, pottan leachar afiyyatan. uveminchat solet ketiva kemitza behedya, uveinach ketiv azkara, veazkara hayenu kometz:
Minchat goyim o nashim. shehitnaddevu achat meellu:
Minchat haomer. azkara ketiv bah:
Minchat chote ukenaot. ketiv behu kemitza:
Minchat chote shel kohanim nikmetzet. af al gav deminchat kohen nisrefet kullah kedichtiv (Vayikra 6) vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye, mikkol makom baya kemitza:

Vehakkometz karev leatzmo vehashshirayim kerevin leatzman. aval letanna kamma en minchat kohen nikmetzet ella nikteret kemot shehi, desavar kol mincha sheshsheyareha neechalim nikmetzet, vesheen sheyareha neechalim enah nikmetzet. vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Ochel maaser. mafrishin mimmennu terumat maaser betohora. ditvul yom veyadayim sheniyyot hen, umaaser rishon kechullin hu chashuv, veen sheni ose shelishi bechullin. veaf al gav dehay maaser tavul litrumat maaser shebbo, leinyan sheni ushelishi hattevel kechullin, hilkach keshemmafrishin mimmennu terumat maaser achar kach haveya tehora:
